articleTitle: Deep Learning Based Segmentation Approach for Automatic Lane Detection in Autonomous Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Lane detection is an essential feature of autonomous vehicle systems, and it can be done automatically. In this research, a Deep Learning (DL)-based segmentation strategy for reliable and rapid lane detection is suggested. In order to study lane identification in autonomous driving scenarios, data will be gathered from the tuSimple website, which offers annotated images created for that purpose. Pre-processing the obtained data entails actions like resizing, normalising, and enhancing to guarantee consistent and high-quality inputs for the models. In this study, the widely-used DL models SegNet and U-Net are implemented to segment lanes. In order to facilitate the classification of lanes and non-lane regions at the pixel level, these models were developed with semantic segmentation tasks in consideration. Mean squared error (MSE), average miss, and computation time are some of the measures that use to assess the effectiveness of both models. The findings prove that both DL-based methods successfully locate lanes. The optimal model for lane recognition in autonomous vehicles are determined based on the evaluation metrics. The best model is the one with the smallest MSE and the smallest average miss value. For real-time applications, computation speed is also critical, therefore the study prioritize models that strike a good compromise between the two.

articleTitle: Exploring Transfer Learning Models for Multi-Class Classification of Infected Date Palm Leaves
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: This research explores the feasibility of leveraging transfer learning models, including AlexNet, VGGNet, and ResNet, alongside a newly devised Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) architecture, for the accurate multi-class classification of infected date palm leaves. The research harnesses the power of transfer learning by adapting these established models to the task of identifying various types of infections in date palm leaves. Alongside, a custom CNN is introduced, designed to capture intricate disease-related patterns and outperform generic architectures. Rigorous experimentation on a carefully annotated dataset enables a comprehensive performance comparison in terms of accuracy, precision, recall, F1 score, and computational efficiency. This investigation not only advances automated plant disease detection but also emphasizes the significance of specialized models in agricultural technology, contributing to sustainable food production and resource preservation.

articleTitle: Crime Pattern Analysis and Prediction Using Regression Models
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: This research intends to address the pressing concern of women's safety by developing predictive models for identifying regional women's crimes, utilizing a range of regression models including Support Vector Regression (SVR), Logistic Regression, Decision Tree (DT), K-Nearest Neighbor (KNN), Random Forest (RF), Linear Regression (LR), and Polynomial Regression. With a comprehensive dataset encompassing historical crime statistics, demographic attributes, and socioeconomic factors, the study aims to construct accurate predictive models by considering crucial elements such as population density, education levels, employment rates, urbanization metrics, and police coverage. Through rigorous cross-validation and comparison using metrics like mean squared error, R-squared, and accuracy, the research seeks to identify the most effective model for predicting crimes against women in different Indian regions. The outcomes of this study have far-reaching implications, offering data-driven insights for authorities, policymakers, and advocacy groups to enhance women's safety by strategically allocating resources, optimizing methods, and implementing proactive measures, thus contributing to an overall safer environment and improved well-being for women throughout the nation.

articleTitle: Recognition of Pistachio Species with Transfer Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: This comprehensive research delves into the intricate task of recognizing diverse pistachio species, spanning applications in agriculture, ecology, and the food industry. By harnessing the power of transfer learning models, including established architectures like AlexNet, VggNet, and ResNet, alongside the novel Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) design enhances the accuracy and efficiency of pistachio species recognition. By fine-tuning pre-trained models and training the CNN from scratch, their ability is leveraged to capture both general and species-specific features. This rigorous evaluation employs an extensive dataset, embracing a wide array of pistachio images, to meticulously gauge model performance using metrics such as accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score. This research not only sheds light on the comparative prowess of transfer learning models and this unique CNN architecture in pistachio recognition but also offers insights with implications for broader fields like agriculture and botany. Ultimately, this study underscores the potential of innovative deep learning approaches to advance species recognition accuracy while showcasing the versatility of the proposed CNN model in diverse botanical applications.

articleTitle: Gradient-Based Design Metrics for Assessment of Underwater Image Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Gradient-based focus metrics are critical in evaluating and enhancing underwater images. Light attenuation, dispersion, and color distortion all contribute to poor image quality in underwater conditions. Various improvement approaches are used to improve these images, and gradient-based focus measures are useful tools for objectively evaluating their effectiveness. Gradient-based metrics, such as Tenengrad (TENG), Variance of Laplacian (LAPV), and Steerable Filters-based (SFIL), evaluate the sharpness and detail enhancement in underwater images by assessing local intensity variations and pixel value changes. These measures highlight regions with fine features, edges, and intensity changes, all of which are important for assessing enhancement quality. The sharper the zone, the higher the metric value, suggesting a successful upgrade. Pre-processing is required for underwater image enhancement evaluation. These measurements pinpoint areas with fine features, edges, and intensity transitions-all of which are essential for assessing the quality of an enhancement. The sharper the zone, which denotes a good augmentation, the higher the metric value. Applying the enhancement method, calculating the focus metric values for the original and enhanced images, and preprocessing to remove noise and rectify color distortions are all steps in the evaluation of underwater image improvement. Researchers can compare these metric values to objectively quantify improvements in image sharpness and detail enhancement, which helps with algorithm selection and parameter adjustment. Gradient-based focus metrics help increase marine research, underwater exploration, and surveillance by offering useful information about the effectiveness of underwater image-enhancing methods. These measures guarantee accurate and trustworthy visual data, advancing the comprehension of the underwater environment.

articleTitle: Novel Energy Management of Hybrid Wind-PV-Battery Supplied DC Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Renewable energy sources for electric power generation are rapidly increasing worldwide. The establishment of hybrid DC microgrids powered by renewable energy sources is becoming more and more popular because of its unique properties, particularly in remote areas Photovoltaic (PV) and PMSG coupled wind energy discussion systems can be integrated anywhere in order to produce reliable electricity. For the system to maximise the usage of renewable energy, an efficient maximum power point tracking (MPPT) device is required. To keep the system's energy balance intact, a storage device-like a battery bank-is integrated into the microgrid via a bidirectional dc-dc converter. Various results with realistic nature are adopted by developing Hardware-in the-Loop through OPAL-RT modules. Extensive results are examined under various case studies to enhance the significant of proposed method.

articleTitle: Industrial Application of the Serial Peripheral Interface Protocol on Field Programmable Gate Arrays
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: The Universal Asynchronous Receiver Transmitter UART, Serial Peripheral Interface (SPI), and Inter-Integrated Circuit (I2C) are widely utilized hardware communication protocols. The process of selecting one option from a set of alternatives may provide difficulties owing to the unique benefits and drawbacks connected with each choice. This article is a thorough examination of the three protocols, with a detailed explanation of their elements, functions, and potential advantages and disadvantages. After doing a comparison investigation of the transmission ranges, it becomes apparent that the modern SPI protocol demonstrates a greater degree of superiority. The UART protocol demonstrates enhanced reliability in performance, however, the SPI protocol provides greater diversity in terms of communication options with fewer resources. In the context of power consumption, it can be observed that UART has superior performance compared to the other two protocols. This study aims to offer a fresh and unique viewpoint on the importance of design.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of an IoT-Based system for Milk Quality Testing
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Milk is composed of 87% water and 13% protein, fat, carbohydrate, vitamin, and mineral content. The most contaminated commodity in the world is milk and milk products. Simple adulterants (water) can be added to natural milk to achieve adulteration. As a result, adulteration greatly lowers the nutritional value of milk. Some milk parameters like pH, TDS, fat, and water content are affected. Physical-chemical tests are used in the dairy industry to monitor milk quality and it is a time-consuming process. As an outcome, these factors need to be examined. A pH meter and a TDS sensor are used to measure the pH and TDS levels, respectively. The fat and water content are measured using an LDR sensor and an electrical-type lactometer. The measured parameters are sent through NodeMCU and it can be monitored in IoT from any location.

articleTitle: RFID Based Bus Tracking System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Efficient and reliable transportation services playa pivotal role in the daily lives of individuals. However, there are instances when the punctuality of these services becomes a source of frustration for passengers. Most of the time, passengers have to wait for extended periods at bus stations without knowing the arrival time of their buses. This research work focuses on the implementation of an RFID system for bus tracking and the development of an Android application for user accessibility. An RFID tag is placed on each bus, and an RFID reader is installed at each bus station. When an RFID reader detects an RFID tag, it sends tag information to the reader. This information is then transmitted to a central database server using Wi-Fi communication. Users can access information about buses using a mobile application. The proposed idea enables passengers to track their bus locations, allowing them to plan their journeys more efficiently and helps individuals by eliminating the need for prolonged waits at bus stations.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Digital Banking Implementation Using Programming Paradigm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: The Bank Management System and ATM paper is designed to provide students with a practical understanding of building a software system to manage banking operations and simulate Automated Teller Machine (ATM) functionalities. The study aims to develop a robust and user-friendly system that facilitates efficient banking processes and enhances customer experience. The study will be implemented using the C programming language, which is widely used in system-level programming and offers the necessary tools for developing a reliable banking system. The paper will involve integrating transaction handling functionalities, including tracking transaction history, generating account statements, and managing account balances.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Based Smart Helmet for Air Quality and Hazardous Event Detection in the Mining Industry
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Ensuring the safety of underground miners is of utmost importance in the mining industry, given the devastating consequences of mining accidents. To address this concern, this research study has developed an intelligent headgear equipped with an array of sensors to continuously monitor the working conditions of miners. This advanced device is engineered to identify critical parameters such as temperature, humidity, concentrations of harmful gases, and vibrations. It is equipped with dedicated sensors for each of these parameters, and it promptly transmits real-time data to a centralized control centre. The control centre can analyse this information and take immediate actions, which may include worker evacuation or improvements to working conditions. The proposed system utilizes an Arduino microcontroller for processing the data from these sensors and then transmits it via a Wi-Fi module. The proposed model has utilized Cloud-based loT and machine learning algorithms to enhance the accuracy of the sensor readings. Specifically, an Artificial Neural Network (ANN) algorithm is employed to train a dataset of sensor information stored in CS V format. This innovative system has the potential to significantly elevate safety standards and minimize the risk of mining accidents.

articleTitle: Advanced UAV Construction Technique and Real-Time Image Processing for Enhanced Aerial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Keeping a record of catastrophes is critical in order to mitigate their consequences, as well as the harm they do to the living world and inhabitants; unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) may mitigate this by outfitting the cameras that capture images of the regions of interest. The rapid expansion of unmanned aerial vehicles in several industries has driven researchers to investigate the potential advantages of employing them in disaster management. UAVs contribute in the construction of the link between those affected, those who survived, and the assigned rescue crew. This work tackles the communication technologies that brought the development of UAV disaster management systems, such as humanitarian interpersonal interaction, and live picture processing, as well as the initial study that was conducted aimed at showing the positive aspects of UAV systems.

articleTitle: A Super Wide Band Antenna for Millimeter Wireless Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: A novel flower slotted fractal (FSF) super wide band (SWB) antenna is suggested for use in millimeter wave wireless applications operating in the C, WLAN, X, Ku, K, and Ka bands. The reported radiator operated over 3.8-41.35 GHz and is printed on a 16x22 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>strip of FR-4 substrate microstrip line along with a beveled partial ground structure. The intended FSF radiator's fluctuating gain of 1.86-7.33 dBi, peak efficiency of 96.55%, and bandwidth ratio (BR) of 10.8:1 make it appropriate for SWB applications.

articleTitle: Robust Digital Watermarking based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: In the generation of big data and systems administration, it is important to build up a safe and strong digital watermarking plan with high computational effectiveness to ensure copyrights of digital works. However, the greater part of the current strategies focuses on robustness and embedding limit, losing a security, or requiring huge computational assets in the encryption procedure. Digital watermarking has become an important method for ensuring the security of digital copyrights and ensuring the authenticity of data because of rapid advancement and broad usage of technologies related to multimedia and network connectivity. which has been used for practical application such as medical application, currency, digital product identification and many more. The success story of digital watermarking techniques deepened on the embedding of the watermark image and present image. In the current decade, the machine learning feature-based watermarking techniques create new milestone concerning security concern. The machine learning and hybrid digital watermarking performances an especially vital role in optimization and selection of features which improves the performance of watermarking process. In this paper, we have presented countless digital watermarking, methods which is based on various machine learning procedures along with their comparison, and limitation.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Approach for Detecting and Preventing Security Attacks in MANETs
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: MANETs are new sort of organizational network that works in a profoundly powerful and unusual atmosphere. Though the flexible nature of MANET is attractive, the dynamic topology of MANETs brings in numerous threats. The existing Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS) doesn't strictly detect the generation of attacks namely Black Hole, Gray Hole, Worm Hole and additional routing attacks. Added to it, the traditional methods of protection techniques won't be sufficed as MANETs are capable of providing network even in the absence of fixed infrastructure. In this proposed system introduces a new technique to detect these attacks and also prevent the generation of attacks by using Black Hole, Gray Hole, Neuro-Fuzzy based (BGNF) based Intrusion Detection System. This BGNF based Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) helps to optimize and minimize the false alarms and data loss.

articleTitle: File Tracking System Using SAP Technology with Cloud Web Services
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Institutional offerings of offers SAP courses in many modules and to varied students are conventional approach. But right now, the total admission process is organised but very time-consuming from the perspective of students as well as the college administration. To make this process more efficient and easier, the institute needed a solution according to the advancing technologies and methods. Right now, online administration processes are in a good position. Many institutes have converted their administration process to an online process. This proposed the idea of the SAP Portal for student convenience. A web portal proposed for the efficient management of SAP activities on a single point with ease in administration for college and dynamic handling provided to students as well. With the usage of latest technologies like ReactJS, Spring Boot, etc., college can convert the offline, time-consuming process to an online, time-saving process. The purpose of this project is to make a unique website totally fulfilling the needs of an administration portal and comprising all the aspects of SAP administration and processes.

articleTitle: Cassava Leaf Disease Classification Using Pre-Trained EfficientN Et Model
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: India relies primarily on agriculture for its subsistence, and the nation's economy is entirely dependent on agricultural products. The demand for food is rising dramatically due to the rapid rate of population growth worldwide. To meet this demand and boost production, farmers are now embracing advanced farming techniques that incorporate artificial intelligence (AI). AI is particularly utilized for crop health observation, plant disease recognition and discovery, and weather and commodity price forecasting. Crop diseases pose a significant threat to food safety, and identifying them manually, especially on larger farms, with the help of experts can be both expensive and time-consuming. To address this issue, deep-based techniques offer image-based automatic process control, inspection, and robot guidance for effective pest and disease control. This article delves into the use of deep learning methods, specifically EfficientN et, for identifying leaf diseases in cassava plants. The main focus is on categorizing leaf diseases using images from the Kaggle dataset. The model achieves impressive results, with the highest accuracy of 92.83% and the lowest loss of 0.2019, both observed at epoch 16.

articleTitle: A Real Time Multiple Object Tracking in Videos using CNN Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Object tracking serves as a fundamental task in the field of computer vision and machine learning. This assignment involves accurately determining the positions of objects across consecutive frames in a video sequence. The objective of this undertaking is to develop a system for detecting and tracking objects using advanced computer vision techniques. The end result of this project is a functional tracking system that combines optical and modern infra-red technologies. This system finds applications in domains like unsupervised surveillance and is notably reliable, capable of functioning independently or seamlessly integrating into more extensive frameworks. The primary aim of this research work is to create an object tracking system using Python and OpenCV, with the intention of providing an efficient and easily accessible solution. The system allows for the tracking of objects from various sources, including uploaded videos and live webcam feeds. In real-world scenarios, such as monitoring traffic on highways, it is often necessary to track multiple objects simultaneously. By employing object tracking algorithms, this project facilitates the simultaneous tracking of numerous objects, such as cars on a highway, enabling the extraction of valuable traffic-related information

articleTitle: Prediction of Soil Fertility Using ML Algorithms and Fertilizer Recommendation System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Prediction of soil nutrient is one of the important primary input management systems to increase crop yield. The nutrient present in the soil plays a major role in the healthy growth of the plants. There are many nutrients present in the soil such as Nitrogen (N), Phosphorus (P), Potassium (K) Calcium (Ca), Magnesium (mg) and Sulphur (S), etc. Farmers do not have sufficient knowledge and information about the nutrient present in the soil. Therefore, they apply a lot of fertilizers in the soil, which causes the unbalanced soil nutrition levels. Hence, the aim this work is to predict the available nutrients in the soil using various Machine Learning (ML) techniques. In this work, three macro nutrients namely NPK which are needed for healthy plant growth are focused. Classification algorithms were used for prediction of soil fertility. Among all of these algorithms, Random Forest give the highest accuracy of 84%. With the results obtained, the model is deployed using web app for recommending fertilizer which is very helpful to the farmers.

articleTitle: Arduino Microcontroller Based Gas Leakage Monitoring and Alerting System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: The proposed work introduces an innovative system for monitoring and alerting of gas leakage. The system is designed to detect gas leaks around a facility, alert personnel and initiate safety protocols. The system is composed of three main components: a gas detector, a data logging system, and an alerting system. The gas detector is designed to detect specific gases and can be placed in strategic locations in a facility to detect any gas leaks. The data logging system is used to store and analyze the data from the gas detectors. This system can be used to identify trends and issues that may lead to gas leaks. The alerting system is used to alert personnel when a gas leak is detected. This system can be used to initiate safety protocols and can be used to notify other personnel of the gas leak. The system is designed to provide a complete solution for monitoring and alerting of gas leaks.

articleTitle: AI Based Variable Step Size Block Least Mean Square Filter for Noise Cancellation System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Most of the Active Noise Cancellation (ANC) systems working properly in low-frequency noises only. To make it suitable for isolating high-frequency noise, it needs an additional circuit which consumes more energy. This problem is mitigated in this study by designing a Variable Step size Block Least Mean Square (VSBLMS) filter which is suitable for an effective noise cancellation system. VSBLMS filter is designed with RCA to make a design area efficient and it is designed with a novel adder to achieve high speed as well as less energy consumption. The proposed filter is designed and simulated using Xilinx ISE 13.2. The simulation results shows that the proposed VSBLMS filter design mitigates the unwanted noises in various frequency bands. The proposed VSBLMS reduces the energy consumption by 9.32%, 27.63%, 13.53%, 11.80%, 10.71 %, 13.14% and 9.26% when compared with state of the art methods.

articleTitle: Sustainable Forest Monitoring: A Comprehensive Wireless Sensor Solution Against Illegal Logging
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: The “Intelligent Forest Protection System” is a wireless network designed to combat illegal tree logging and perform comprehensive environmental monitoring. It comprises three units: Tree Unit, Gateway, and Forest Officer Unit. The Tree Unit uses vibration sensors and continuity checkers to detect illegal cutting attempts, while also measuring temperature, humidity, and rainfall for environmental insights. The Gateway connects multiple Tree Units, receiving alerts about illegal logging and environmental data like temperature, humidity, rainfall, and fire. It integrates HC12, GPS, and GSM modem for seamless communication. The Forest Officer Unit receives realtime alerts through GSM, empowering immediate responses to potential illegal activities. Additionally, the officer gains access to environmental metrics via a mobile app, enabling proactive conservation efforts and timely responses to forest threats. The Intelligent Forest Protection System combines cutting-edge sensor technology with efficient communication to combat illegal logging and monitor environmental conditions effectively, contributing to the preservation of valuable forests and ecosystems.

articleTitle: Chess Piece Classification Via Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Chess, one of the oldest and most intellectually demanding board games, continues to captivate players and researchers alike. Chess piece classification, the task of automatically recognizing and distinguishing different chess pieces on a chessboard, is a fundamental problem in computer vision with applications in chess analysis, game recording, and chess engine development. In recent years, Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) have emerged as a powerful tool for image classification tasks, achieving remarkable performance in various domains. The proposed research study highlights the importance of chess piece classification via Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and explores its potential benefits. By leveraging the ability of CNNs to extract complex features from images, chess piece classification can be significantly improved. CNNs can capture local spatial patterns and hierarchical representations, allowing for the accurate identification of chess pieces with high precision and recall. The advantages of CNN-based chess piece classification extend beyond accurate piece recognition. These models can provide valuable insights into game analysis, facilitating move prediction, board evaluation, and player behavior analysis. Furthermore, CNN-based classification can enhance chess recording and broadcasting, enabling real-time annotation of chess games and enhancing the viewing experience for spectators. Overall, this research study underscores the significance of chess piece classification via Convolutional Neural Networks, showcasing its potential to revolutionize various aspects of chess analysis, game recording, and chess engine development, ultimately advancing the understanding and enjoyment of this timeless game.

articleTitle: Breast Cancer Prediction Using a Deep Learning Algorithm on the Cloud Medical Data
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Recent strides in data generation have given rise to an unprecedented surge in information accumulation, marking the advent of the big data era. Unfortunately, conventional machine learning algorithms find it challenging to adeptly manage the distinctive characteristics presented by big data. This study is centered on the task of breast cancer prediction in the midst of this data-rich landscape. Specifically, we delve into two pivotal data types: gene expression (GE) and DNA methylation (DM).Our objective revolves around unlocking the potential of Deep Learning algorithms, both when applied individually to each dataset and when they come together in synergy. For this purpose, we've elected MATLAB as our primary platform. At the heart of breast cancer prediction, we employ the Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) algorithm, renowned for its proficiency in pattern recognition and feature extraction. Our study is underpinned by a comprehensive analysis that encompasses GE, DM, and the amalgamated GE and DM datasets.Furthermore, we gauge the performance of the CNN algorithm by placing it head-to-head with the Random Forest (RF) algorithm, a widely adopted choice in machine learning for classification tasks. The outcomes of our experiments vividly underscore the superiority of our approach, especially when we harness the potential of the GE dataset. This particular configuration yielded the highest accuracy and the most cost-effective results among all the classifiers considered. These findings serve as a beacon, illuminating the remarkable efficacy of Deep Learning techniques in the domain of breast cancer prediction, particularly when set against the backdrop of big data. This study underscores the remarkable potential of Deep Learning algorithms as they navigate the complex healthcare landscape and promises more accurate, cost-efficient diagnostic tools on the horizon.

articleTitle: IoT-Enabled Intelligent Maternal Intensive Care: A Research Study
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) has become one of the most significant instruments for pervasive and intelligent systems for automated diagnostics in the healthcare industry. This study suggests creating sophisticated monitoring systems for mother and foetal signals in high-risk pregnancies. The suggested system employs several sensors, including an ECG sensor, FHR sensor, and UC sensor, all of which are coupled to a microcontroller unit. The MCU analyses the sensor data and sends it wirelessly to a web server, which is presented on a graphical user interface after being processed by the web server. The GUI gives medical practitioners a thorough analysis of the pregnancy, including historical trends and recent data that may be utilized to spot possible issues and act quickly. The system is created to be scalable, affordable, and user-friendly, making it appropriate for implementation in both developed and developing nations. Overall, the suggested method offers a sub-stantial advancement in the field of pregnancy monitoring by providing both healthcare professionals and patients with better accuracy, dependability, and accessibility. This IoT-based technology has the potential to enhance health outcomes for pregnant women all around the world by revolutionizing pregnancy monitoring.

articleTitle: Prediction of Stock Market Using LSTM-RNN Model
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Each expanding and flourishing financial system relies on the stock market, and each money invested in the business seeks to maximize revenue while minimizing related hazards. Because of its intrinsic interplay, non-linearity, and complexity, predicting stock collective qualities has invariably been both appealing and complicated for investors. Consequently, various research on stock market predictive models utilizing technical or fundamental assessment have been performed utilizing different soft-computing methods and techniques. It has never been convenient to buy shares in a portfolio of resources; the unusually volatile economic stock does not enable convenient designs to predict prospective investment value systems with greater accuracy. Machine learning (ML), which involves teaching machines to execute activities that would ordinarily necessitate human intelligence, is presently the dominant pattern in science investigation. This research study examines a novel method for predicting stock market prices by using recurrent neural networks (RNN), specifically the LSTM-Long-Short Term Memory. The main objective of this investigation is to determine the impact of the prediction using ML technique can forecast events.

articleTitle: Blockchain Technology for Secure and Efficient Land Registration Management: A Promising Paradigm Shift in India
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Land registration in India is a critical process that helps to ensure secure and efficient land ownership. However, traditional land registration systems are often faced with challenges such as corruption, fraud, and inefficiencies. The emergence of blockchain technology provides a hopeful resolution to these challenges. It provides a secure as well as transparent decentralized platform for the management of land registration. This research work explores the potential of “blockchain technology” in enhancing land registration management. The study examines the current state of land registration systems and identifies the challenges faced by traditional systems. Furthermore, the research discusses the fundamental concepts of blockchain technology and how it can be applied to land registration management. The study presents a proposed blockchain-based land registration system that provides transparency, immutability, and security of land ownership records. The proposed system is built on a decentralized platform that eliminates the need for intermediaries, reduces the cost of transactions, and increases the efficiency of land registration management. The prototype demonstrated the potential of blockchain technology in enhancing land registration management by providing a secure, transparent, and efficient system. In conclusion, the study highlights the potential of blockchain technology in revolutionizing land registration management. The proposed system offers a more secure, transparent, and efficient way of managing land registration. This research contributes to the growing body of literature on blockchain technology applications and provides insights for policymakers and practitioners in the land registration sector.

articleTitle: Optimizing Packrat Parsing with Non-Linear Data Structures for Memoization
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: This research paper presents the implementation of memoization in packrat parsing using non-linear data structures. Packrat parsing is a powerful parsing technique that guarantees linear time parsing for grammars that can be expressed using parsing expression grammars (PEGs), introduced by Bryan Ford in 2002. Memoization is a technique that can be applied to ensure linear time parsing by storing intermediate parsing results. Comparative performance of existing implementations with the proposed approach on various grounds is presented.

articleTitle: Cyclone Intensity Estimation Using CNN
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Tropical cyclones are potential for causing extensive damage to both lives and property. Consequently, accurately predicting the intensity of these cyclones in advance becomes paramount. To address this, a comprehensive system has been devised to estimate the strength of tropical cyclones. This system comprises a database encompassing labels and images, containing vital information about cyclones, including their names, occurrence years, timings, locations, and corresponding images. Prior to analysis, the data undergoes preprocessing procedures like standardization to ensure uniformity, and data augmentation to balance the dataset's representation. A key component of this augmentation is the introduction of additional data instances to enhance the dataset's diversity. The core of the approach involves the utilization of a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) model. This model is meticulously trained over 100 epochs using the rmsprop optimizer. The training process culminates in the computation of pertinent metrics, revealing a mean absolute error of 10.83 knots and a root mean square error of 14.49 knots. The efficacy of the model's training is further highlighted through graphical representations of errors, facilitating a visual grasp of the model's performance. The final step entails the application of the trained model for predictions on test images. Additionally, the initiative extends to the development of an interactive web application. This application serves as a platform for visualizing cyclones that have occurred. Users can input specific years and cyclone names to access relevant information. Overall, this system embodies a comprehensive strategy for estimating tropical cyclone intensity. It combines meticulous preprocessing, advanced machine learning techniques, and a user-friendly interface to enhance our understanding and preparedness in the face of these natural phenomena.

articleTitle: Enhanced Efficiency of CsFAMA-Based PSCs Through Increased Absorber Layer Thickness: A Numerical Simulation Study Using SCAPS-1D
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Cesium formamidinium methylammonium (CsFAMA) perovskite photovoltaic cells have demonstrated remarkable efficiency and reliability. In this investigation, CsFAMA functioned as the absorbent material, with <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{TiO}_{2}$</tex> as the ETL and <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{Cu}_{2}\mathrm{O}$</tex> as the HTL in a PSC. Because of its excellent optoelectronic features, such as a large absorption coefficient, good charge-carrying transport, and extended carrier lifetime, the CsFAMA perovskite absorber material had been employed. The thickness of the absorbing layer improves from 100 to 1000nm, and the mathematical simulation is performed by S CAPS -1D tool. According to the simulation's findings, the high-power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 17.51%, 0.98V for the open circuit voltage, 23.56 mA/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> for the short-circuit current density <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(\mathrm{J}_{\text{SC}})$</tex>, and 80.77% for the fill factor characterize CsFAMA PSCs. As a result, increasing the thickness of the layer that absorbs light improves the total PCE of the cell.

articleTitle: Electricity Generation of Dynamic Bifacial Solar Panels Using IoT
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Recently, there has been a surge in interest in photovoltaic (PV) panels with dual-sided capabilities. The increasing availability of bifacial photovoltaic (PV) modules on the market has resulted in higher energy generation capabilities as compared to traditional single-sided solar panels. Because of its increased ability to absorb and apply backside irradiation, this technology beats monofacial panels. Bifacial photovoltaic (PV) technology is a method of capturing light from both incidence and albedo surfaces. This process causes a rise in power density. Integration of these resources into the electrical system has the potential to improve energy efficiency and supply reliability. Bifacial modules have dual-sided qualities and are deliberately positioned to ensure alignment with the roof surface. This process prevents any reflected light from reaching the cells beneath. In comparison to conventional modules, bifacial modules have exhibited higher performance on flat corporate roofs and ground-mounted arrays. There is more spatial freedom in these settings for rotating the modules and redirecting the light to the back of the modules. The goal of this research is to assess the efficacy of bifacial solar panels in Qatar's winter and summer climates.

articleTitle: Brain MRI Classification Using Transfer Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Brain tumors must be grouped to be diagnosed and treated correctly. Deep learning methods have recently showed potential in the classification of brain cancers using diagnostic pictures like magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) scans. This work demonstrates the obstacles and future objectives for classifying brain cancers using deep learning. It talks about what has been done recently in this area. This research study discusses how convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and some variations, such as transfer learning and ensemble models, can be used to classify brain tumors. Also, this study compares how well different CNN architectures work on different kinds of brain cancer, like meningiomas, gliomas, and pituitary tumors. Lastly, discusses about what is wrong with and hard about the current deep learning-based approaches and suggest new ways to look into them.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Approach for Prediction of Ammonia in Freshwater Bodies
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Water is a fundamental need for the survival of both human beings and aquatic species such as fish. This work aims to forecast the concentration of Ammonia in freshwater ecosystems by considering three distinct variables: pH, Dissolved Oxygen, and Chemical Oxygen Demand. The work emphasizes the detrimental impact of Ammonia on freshwater fish and the need to accurately estimate ammonia levels using the Machine Learning algorithm for implementing proactive measures. The data is pre-processed to mitigate the risk of overfitting in machine learning models. A total of six supervised machine learning algorithms are used to make predictions, and the model that exhibits the highest level of accuracy is chosen. Subsequently, performance metrics such as Mean Square Error (MSE), Root Mean Square Error (RMSE), and R2_Score are used to assess the accuracy of the machine learning models. Based on the work conducted, the Random Forest algorithm gives the best results and is the most suitable Machine-Learning method for predicting Ammonia levels in freshwater bodies.

articleTitle: Comparative Evaluation of Transfer Learning Models for Knee Osteoarthritis Severity Classification Using KL Grading Scale
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Knee Osteoarthritis (KOA) is a prevalent and debilitating joint condition that affects millions of individuals worldwide. Early and accurate diagnosis of KOA severity is crucial for effective treatment planning and patient management. One widely accepted method for assessing KOA severity is the Kellgren-Lawrence (KL) grading scale, which categorizes KOA into different stages based on radiographic evidence from knee X-ray images. This study addresses the critical need for an efficient and accurate classification system for KOA severity, leveraging the power of deep learning and transfer learning techniques. The primary objective of this research work is to identify the most effective model for classifying KOA severity levels from knee X-ray images using the KL grading scale. This study has encountered significant challenges related to preprocessing of knee images and system computation time. Initially, knee images required intricate preprocessing steps to enhance data quality, and the computational time posed constraints on real-time applications. To overcome these challenges, this study has employed advanced techniques and conducted a comprehensive performance analysis of various deep learning models, including NasNetLarge, AlexNet, Inception V3, DenseNet, Mobile Net, and ResNet. These models have shown significant promise in various image classification tasks, making them compelling candidates for the task of KOA severity classification.

articleTitle: DDCATF: Deep Learning Approach for Detection of Cybercrime Activities Based on Temporal Features
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: The detection of cybercrime activities holds paramount importance in today's interconnected digital landscape. As technology becomes more integrated into every aspect of one's lives, the potential for cybercrime and its impacts have increased exponentially. In this context, the presented research employs a Deep Learning approach for Detection of Cybercrime Activities based on Temporal Features (DDCATF), specifically leveraging Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), to effectively detect and combat cybercrime activities. The significance of this approach lies in its potential to empower numerous organizations in identifying intricate and ever-evolving threats. By integrating temporal features into the detection process, these organizations can substantially strengthen their cybersecurity capabilities. To accomplish this objective, the research makes use of publicly accessible datasetnamed SIMARGL2022 and compared with other benchmark datasets: KddCup99 and CICIDS2017. These datasets serve as valuable resources for evaluating the CNN efficacy in identifying a diverse range of cybercrime activities. To determine the performance, a comprehensive set of evaluation metrics including accuracy, precision, recall, and f-measure are employed.

articleTitle: Automated Framework for the Tuberculosis Detection and Classification in X-Ray Images Using Deep Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: This study focuses on utilizing deep learning algorithms to detect Tuberculosis (TB) through the examination of chest radiograph (X-ray) images. The primary goal of this research study is to develop and demonstrate a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) based method specifically designed for the TB detection in chest images. The algorithm developed comprises of three key stages: pre-processing, feature extraction, and classification. During the initial pre-processing stage, the input chest X-ray image undergoes normalization and resizing operations to establish a standardized and consistent fixed size. This step aims to enhance the uniformity and comparability of the images. The CNN technique is utilized to automatically identify desirable characteristics from the X-ray of chest image during the feature extraction step. The chest X-ray image is classified as tuberculosis positive or negative during the classification step using the retrieved features. The findings of this study could enhance the precision and speed of tuberculosis detection utilising chest X-ray imaging. The proposed algorithm has the potential to assist healthcare professionals in the early and accurate detection of TB.

articleTitle: Optimization of Operating Parameters of Wire EDM Using Design of Experiments Criteria
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: This research article delves into the optimization of WEDM operating parameters through the application of Design of Experiments (DOE) principles. As traditional machining techniques give way to non-traditional methods for enhanced surface quality and intricate form geometries, wire EDM stands out as a prominent contender. Focusing on machining brass-based metals, renowned for applications like gears, bearings, and locks, the study aims to find the most effective process parameters. The investigation involves pivotal factors including pulse on/off, servo voltage, and input current, with MRR and surface roughness serving as key performance indicators. Employing the Taguchi L9 orthogonal array, the research dissects the influence of each control component on performance measures via S/N ratio analysis. Notably, the study underscores the malleability of wire EDM settings in enhancing both MRR and surface quality, effectively harnessing the Taguchi approach to attain an optimized parameter set.

articleTitle: Machine Learning-Based Approach for Predicting Battery Remaining Useful Life (RUL): A Data-Driven Methodology
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: In electric vehicles (EVs), lithium-ion batteries playa vital role; determining how long they will be useful is essential to ensuring their stability, longevity, and safety. In the subject of battery health management, it is crucial to provide a machine-learning approach for assessing battery health states that has high generalization, accuracy, and robustness. This work summarizes recent research on machine learning algorithms for data-driven approaches. The values of the variables, including current, voltage, and temperature, are used as the dataset. A Decision Tree (DT) algorithm and Gradient Boosting (GB) algorithm are proposed for the RUL prediction of batteries, and the model's error analysis is carried out to enhance a performance parameter for the battery. The prediction results are rated numerically using statistical markers like MAE, MSE, and RMSE. Also, the testing consequences revealed that the presented methods give better results than other machine learning techniques, considering various performance criteria.

articleTitle: English to Meiteilon Machine Translation Using Seq2Seq with Long Short-Term Memory
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Neural Machine Translation (NMT) is a cutting-edg<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">e</sup> strategy that has produced significant advancements in the field of machine translation for translating one language into another when compared to more conventional methods. The people of India speak their distinct regional languages for communication. Given the wide variety of languages in India, translation of language is crucial. However, it is nearly impossible for a human to translate one language into another language. This is achievable through Neural Machine Translation. English is offered as a second additional official language in India. However, India uses English extremely little, creating a communication gap. Numerous web applications translate one language to another language. Some of these are Google Translate, Translate, Deep Learning, and Microsoft Translator. But these applications do not support the regional languages. This paper aims to propose a language translation model using a sequence-to-sequence model with Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) for translating English to Meiteilon.

articleTitle: Analysis of Designed Power System with Power Quality Improvement by Using UPQC
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: This research study uses Unified Power Quality Conditioner (UPQC) to reduce voltage sag/swell and current sag/swell using realtime data after the power system data is collected throughout a variety of time periods and fault conditions. The findings indicate that UPQC is more effective than different FACTS controller devices. Analysis of the designed power system's results and comparison with the actual power system follow. MATLAB is used to simulate and model a distribution system. A fault is applied and examined at the distribution line using a scope that displays the magnitude of the system voltage per unit of time. Results for current swell and voltage sag in this system are simulated and compared with actual values.

articleTitle: Machine Learning-Based Intrusion Detection for Mitigating Denial of Service Attacks in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Due to the characteristics of certain networks, particularly their constrained hardware capabilities, and infrastructure-less design, the widespread adoption of Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs) has resulted in a number of security vulnerabilities. One of the most frequent threats to these networks is the denial-of-service attack. It is difficult to build an intrusion detection and prevention system to reduce the consequences of a denial-of-service attack. The use of a few machine learning techniques is suggested in this research as a way to identify vulnerabilities on a specified dataset. Regular profiles and various Denial of Service attack scenarios in WSNs are both included in the dataset that was used. According to the experimental findings, the hyperparameter tuning technique outperformed other techniques with greater true positive rates (higher) and better false positive rates (lower).

articleTitle: Intelligent Power Saving Street Lighting System with Vehicle Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Day by day, demand has been rising in recent years. According to research, lighting the streets uses a significant amount of power in many nations. The majority of basic street lighting systems is turned ON and OFF at predetermined intervals of time. This study aims to create a power saving street light system that will useless electricity on roads during the absence of vehicles. Significant electrical power is saved by the suggested system. The lifespan of the lights could also be extended as a result. If no vehicles are moving through the road, this mechanism will operate to keep the street lighting intensity at 40% of its maximum level. When the IR sensor detects movement of the car, the street lights will be turned all the way up. LDR is used by the technology to differentiate between day and night. Once daytime is recognized, all of the streetlights will be in the OFF position. An Arduino microcontroller manages the system. The Arduino receives a signal from the IR sensor, which doubles as a car detector, and modifies the LED's brightness. The energy-efficient street lighting control system's prototype also has safety features, as it only dims the light slightly so that people can still see it clearly from a distance and fully turns on the light if it senses movement.

articleTitle: An Advanced Feature Extraction Approach for Classifying and Categorizing Complex Data by Using the MMRDL Framework
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Nowadays, Machine learning (ML) plays a significant role in processing multimedia based on user search queries. To develop an efficient classification model that processes the high dimensional data, an ensemble model combined with deep feature extraction and robust classifier. Combining the three algorithms generate the stochastic belief space in this work. The planning of these algorithms based on maximum entropy reinforcement learning (ME-RL), and generative adversary model (GAM). The comparison between various unmodeled adversarial methods is suggested to achieve robustness because the malicious behaviors were applied in the simulation framework to reduce the agent's action predictability. Guided Deep Learning (DL), the reinforcement-based approach, can be employed for multi-model categorization. The text and image data applied on a single neural network method may categorize. The proposed system properly understands the belief space policy using feature extraction on text and image datasets. The proposed model shows the maximum entropy depends on the input dataset.

articleTitle: Crop Monitoring System Using GSM
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Crop Monitoring System (CMS) presented in this paper leverages GSM technology to establish a robust framework for real-time crop field management and optimization [1]. The system is comprised of an array of intelligent sensors, a high-performance microcontroller, a GSM communication module, a centralized server infrastructure, and an intuitive web interface [2]. This integrated solution offers farmers and agriculturists unprecedented insights into crop conditions, enabling informed decision-making for en-hanced yield and resource conservation. The operational workflow of CMS encompasses several distinct phases. Beginning with precise data collection, a suite of specialized sensors captures vital parameters such as ambient temperature, humidity, soil moisture, and light intensity. This data forms the foundation for informedcrop analysis. The microcontroller undertakes the task of processing raw sensor data, converting it into a digital format suitable for transmission [5]. The GSM module facilitates seamless data transfer over the cellular network to a remote server, ensuring data integrity and security. The heart of CMS lies within its centralized server infrastructure, where a robust database stores the transmitted data. A user-friendly web interface translates this data into visually comprehensible graphs, charts, and real-time updates, enabling users to monitor crop conditions remotely [10]. Furthermore, the system employs pre-defined thresholds to generate timely alerts when any parameter deviates from the acceptable range [9]. This feature empowers farmers to take proactive measures to safeguard crop health and optimize yields. An innovative facet of CMS is its remote control capability, enabling users to manage irrigation systems and other equipment remotely. This dynamic feature streamlines agricultural operations, allowing for precision adjustments in response to real-time data, thus minimizing resource wastage and fostering sustainable practices

articleTitle: Women's Safety in Cities Using Android
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Women's safety must be addressed globally, not just in India. Women's Safety in Urban Areas is a concern to overcome this developed an Android Application. Program is designed to make women feel more secure and protected. Researchers developed an Android app titled “Women's Safety in Cities Using Android” in response to many women feeling insecure in significant cities. When the time arrives, a single mouse touch is required to activate this application. When activated, the app will use the user's GPS coordinates to pinpoint the user's precise location before sending a message to the user's contacts containing a link to the location's specific URL. The application is distinguished from the composition by its continuous messaging capabilities. If it does not halt the service after it has begun, the app will send location updates every five minutes to respective contacts. Shake detectors enable real-time location tracking of the victim via SMS, which expedites the rescue procedure and increases the likelihood of a positive outcome.

articleTitle: A Multi-Layered Learning (MLL) Model for Detecting Diabetes
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Diabetes is a chronic metabolic disorder affecting many of the world's population. Diabetes detection is critical for timely intervention and effective disease management. Machine learning techniques, particularly deep learning approaches, have shown promising results in diabetes detection in recent years. The authors propose a multilayered approach for diabetes detection that combines enhanced feature selection techniques with a Fully Connected Recurrent Neural Network (FRNN). The proposed approach's first layer involves feature selection, identifying the most informative features from the input dataset. Traditional feature selection methods, such as correlation analysis and statistical tests, are improved using domain knowledge and data preprocessing techniques. It reduces the dimensionality of the input data and removes irrelevant or redundant features, improving the efficiency and accuracy of the subsequent classification model. FRNN is used in the second layer to detect diabetes. The FRNN is a neural network architecture that effectively captures temporal dependencies in sequential data. It comprises recurrent connections, allowing the network to retain information from previous time steps, making it suitable for analyzing time series data like medical records. The proposed multilayered approach is tested on a large diabetes dataset with various clinical features and patient records. Standard evaluation metrics such as precision, accuracy, recall, specificity, and F1-score used to evaluate the proposed approach's performance. The experimental results show that enhanced feature selection and the FRNN model outperform other diabetes detection methods. The MLL achieves high accuracy and robustness when dealing with the complexity and variability of diabetes data. These findings suggest that a multilayered approach to diabetes detection and management can improve patient outcomes and healthcare efficiency.

articleTitle: Innovative Approach for Sustainable Electricity Generation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Nowadays the availability of the primary source of energy (i.e., Fossil fuel) is being reduced day by day hence the necessity to find a new source of energy is going up. This paper explores the possibilities of converting mechanical force and sound (acoustic) energy into usable electrical energy. This method of conversion can be used on highways or bridges where vehicles are constantly moving. Electricity can be generated from the force due to the weight the vehicles exert while moving and the sound from the vehicles and noises they make from horns. These noises they produce are one of the major reasons of noise pollution in the populated areas. This can be converted into electrical energy which will be used to charge the batteries during the daytime and during the night time it can be used to glow the street lights and even used to charge electrical vehicles. This can reduce transmission losses as the electricity used to glow the street lights. LDR sensor can be used to perform the automatic switching of the street lights during night-time. A battery charged by the energy produced by the model proposed in this paper can be connected to a microcontroller (Arduino UNO) which can be connected to the street lights and LDR sensor, which will perform the switching function automatically. This model will work with higher efficiency in a tunnel- type road system where the sound produced by the vehicles will be more concentrated and space for the vehicles to move will be less. The proposed new model combines a piezo-transducers and microphone in parallel to increase the current produced. This new system with an LDR sensor makes it a real-life high energy efficient model.

articleTitle: Automatic Detection of Plasmodium Parasite Using Convolution Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: The health industry is quite active and malaria is the deadliest disease on earth. A laboratory or skilled technician will often do a schematic analysis of a patient's blood film under a microscope to look for parasite-infected red blood cells. The procedure is ineffective, and the diagnosis is based on the expertise and experience of the individuals who will be performing the examination. Malaria diagnosis using a blood smear has already been carried out using deep learning algorithms. The suggested method uses image-based diagnosis with CNNs and VGG models to accomplish this goal, yielding a high accuracy of 94.7% and precision in differentiating infected and uninfected cells.

articleTitle: Leveraging Subcontract Task Offloading in SDN- Assisted Cloud Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Cloud computing is the process of transmitting computer services over the internet. It facilitates the users to obtain the access of wide range of resources, including processing power, storage, databases, networking, software, and more, without owing their own infrastructure. Cloud computing has transformed the way businesses and individuals use and manage technology, offering a scalable and flexible model for IT consumption. Task offloading to the cloud is the technique of transferring certain computing workloads or activities from local devices (such as smartphones, laptops, or edge devices) to a cloud infrastructure for execution. This offloading aims to leverage the cloud's computational resources, scalability, and processing capabilities to enhance the performance, efficiency, and user experience of applications. Software Defined Network (SDN) based task offloading using subcontracting in cloud layer has been proposed in the paper to manage the temporary overload to maintain the QoS of the cloud system.

articleTitle: Design Thinking Approaches to Industrial Sales Forecasting with Advanced Data Analytical Tool
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Data Mining is the best technology that are mostly used in industrial companies nowadays. In context of the knowledge discovery from the data, then machine learning plays an important role by applying some intelligent patterns to generate the results. There are several benefits of using machine learning like early detection, marketing solution availability, possible marketing sales methods and it also helps in creating new marketing policies. Broadly, there are two types of learning exists i.e. supervised and unsupervised. Clustering is considered as the unsupervised learning and classification, regression comes under supervised learning. In clustering the set of data is partitioned into different groups in order to achieve higher similarity ratio between the objects of the same group. It has a wide application area which includes image processing, pattern recognition, analysis of purchase pattern of the customer. The intent of the current research is to boost the accuracy of future revenue forecasts through review and evaluation of intelligible forecasting techniques. Using classic forecast methods can be challenging due to the precise nature of sales forecasts and big data. All of these problems might be overcome through the application of various data mining strategies. The research study's final portion covers various indicators and approaches for evaluating sales. In accordance with a performance assessment, the model of prediction that is most suitable for forecasting a sales trend is presented. In terms of the accuracy and dependability of reliable forecasting and foresight methodologies, the findings are presented.

articleTitle: AttriML: An Intelligent Approach to Predict Employee Attrition using Exploratory Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: With the existing issues related to an employee working for any organization, Attrition is one of the critical issues in the present situation despite the adjustments in the outer condition. It is a steady loss and is supposed to be a slight worker decrease through renunciation, demise, and retirement. When a very much prepared and all-around adjusted worker(employee) leaves the association for any explanation, it makes a vacant space in an association (i.e.) there happens to be a vacuum in the association. It makes it extraordinarily difficult for a Human Resource workforce to fill the hole that has happened. Current Human Resource chiefs are finding a way to lessen the employee wearing down rate. It has been a crucial test for the present managers because they cannot determine the reasons behind any attrition. This paper aims at finding the reasons behind Attrition by applying various machine learning algorithms for making predictions.

articleTitle: Smart Electric Vehicle with Safety System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Smart Electric Vehicles (EVs) are becoming increasingly popular as an environmentally-friendly, user-friendly, and cost-effective means of trans port. The Smart Electric Vehicle with Safety System is a groundbreaking innovation that combines cutting-edge technology with EVs to enhance safety, monitoring, and user experience. This system integrates the Internet of Things (IoT) and a feature-rich mobile app to provide real-time updates and critical information about the EV's parameters. The mobile app empowers drivers with essential insights, such as battery level and speed, ensuring efficient range management and confident driving. An intuitive battery level gauge and s peed graph assist drivers in making informed decisions for their journeys. The SEVs goes beyond conventional safety features by incorporating advanced monitoring capabilities. It includes obstacle detection, alerting drivers to potential hazards, and indicating the brake application status for improved control over the vehicle. Furthermore, the system boasts an automatic accident detection mechanism that triggers an emergency response in case of an accident. The app promptly sends an alert with the vehicle's real-time location to the registered mobile number, enabling immediate assistance. The SEVSS heralds a new era in electric mobility by fostering safer driving practices and offering a user-friendly experience. As the automotive industry embraces smart solutions, this system paves the way for the widespread adoption of EVs, contributing to a greener and more sustainable future for transportation.

articleTitle: Multi-Modal Based Fusion Emotion Identification Using Inception V3 Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Multimodal emotion recognition aims to identify human emotions from various modalities, such as facial expressions, voice and text. Combining multiple modalities yields more accurate and reliable recognition results. Data collection, feature extraction, and classification are essential processes in emotion recognition. Datasets are used for data collection, while feature extraction extracts relevant features for emotional states. Deep learning techniques, such as Inception and deep learning models, are employed for classification. Multimodal emotion recognition can benefit industries like healthcare, education, and entertainment, but still faces challenges such as dataset size, feature extraction methods, and contextual data. A multimodal emotion recognition system combines multiple models to accurately identify emotions and improve performance.

articleTitle: Design and Fabrication of IoT Based Mechanized Loading and Unloading of Gunny bags in Godowns
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: The main objective of the proposed work is to automate the process using weaved bags. The creation of a tool that can automatically load and unload gunny sacks is the aim of this work. Microcontrollers and sensors are used throughout the process. The plan is to physically insert the bag, fill it with rice automatically, then sew the bags together. The use of a conveyor facilitates the transportation of the bags. At the end, the bags have the QR codes adhered to them. This makes it simple to trace the whereabouts of the rice bag. The logistics team's process is facilitated by this. Basic details like rice kind, weight, producer name, price, date of manufacturing, and expiration date are also included in the QR code. An advanced option for simple bag tracking is this QR code. Less effort and time from humans will be used in this operation. This also makes QR code tracking simple. The current system is expensive and intricate. There is a lot of labour involved in loading and unloading. The system places a lot of emphasis on big businesses. Small-scale industries are unable to use the current system. The current models bundle with plastic covers, which is harmful for the environment. While the weighing alone is done automatically, packing and sealing are done by hand. More human intervention results from this. The suggested solution is easy to use and economical. Implementing the mechanism is simple. The mechanism can be altered. The machine's design is based on an intuitive mechanism, and installation is simple. The addition of QR codes makes bag tracking simple.

articleTitle: Water Level Indicator with Level Set Motor Cutoff
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: This research study presents a hardware implementation of a “Water Level Indicator with Level Set Motor Cutoff” to address the crucial issue of water wastage and prevent motor burnout due to the absence of water in overhead tanks or reservoirs. The system provides an efficient and reliable solution by indicating the water level in the tank and automatically cutting off the motor when the water level reaches a predetermined low threshold. It consists of several key components, including water level sensors, a microcontroller unit (MCU), an LCD display, and a relay circuit. The water level sensors are strategically placed at different levels in the tank to detect the water level accurately. These sensors send signals to the MCU, which processes the data and displays it on the LCD screen, providing real-time information about the water level. The MCU also controls the motor operation. When the water level falls below the critical threshold, the MCU triggers the relay circuit, cutting off the power supply to the motor. This feature prevents the motor from running dry, which could lead to severe damage and unnecessary power consumption. The system is designed to be user-friendly and easily installable. It requires minimal maintenance and can be integrated with existing water supply setups. The LCD display provides clear and concise information, ensuring that users can monitor the water level at a glance. The motor cutoff functionality eliminates the need for manual intervention, making the system efficient and convenient for users. The water level indicator with motor cutoff offers numerous benefits, including water conservation, reduced electricity consumption, and extended motor lifespan.

articleTitle: An Automated Epilepsy Seizure Detection System (AESD) Using Deep Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Epilepsy is a brain disorder that results in abnormal electrical activity in the brain. Epilepsy is also called a seizure disorder. The diagnosis of epilepsy can be made if the person suffers from two or more seizures. Seizures are the main symptom of epilepsy. Different models are introduced to diagnose epileptic seizures with the help of electroencephalography (EEG). EEG is wavelet signals that are most widely used to find the abnormal events identified in the brain. Deep Learning (DL) algorithms can efficiently discover epileptic seizures based on their features. In this study, an automated epilepsy seizure detection system (AESD) is developed to diagnose and detect epilepsy seizures from the human brain. A pre-trained DL model VGG-19 is used to train the EEG sample datasets. VGG-19 helps to extract the features of ECG samples and transfer the data to the proposed approach for better outcomes. The existing models analyze many challenges to seeing this disease. The dataset attributes include patient family history, age, and information about medicines that have been used for a long time. The experiments use Python libraries for DL algorithms, such as Keras, Pandas, Matplotlib, and Numpy.
