The performance of the proposed approach is analyzed based on parameters such as accuracy, sensitivity, specificity, and F1-score.

articleTitle: Brushless Motor Speed Regulation Using Field Oriented Control Algorithm and IoT
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: A novel approach for efficiently and accurately controlling Brushless direct current (BLDC) motors using internet of things (IoT) monitoring, a Field-Oriented Control (FOC) algorithm, and a quasi Z-source (QZS) inverter is presented in this article. The suggested method enables real-time modifications to the speed and performance of BLDC motors through remote monitoring and control. By transforming the three-phase stator currents and the position of the rotor into a rotating reference frame, the FOC algorithm allows the control system to precisely monitor and adjust the motor's magnetic field. To ensure the motor runs smoothly and reliably, the solar photovoltaic (PV) powered QZS inverter controls the voltage and current it receives. Motor performance may be precisely controlled due to the use of back electromotive force (EMF) estimation for exact measurement of rotor position and speed. Simulation and experimental findings verify the proposed system's efficacy in controlling BLDC motors efficiently and precisely with IoT monitoring. The suggested method might be used in a variety of contexts, from robotics and automation to electric automobiles.

Author Keywords: internet of things and motor regulation

articleTitle: Bridging Devotion and Safety: IoT-Driven Contactless Temple Bell Ringing During the Pandemic Era
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: An IoT-driven Contactless Solution for Temple Bell Ringing in the Pandemic Era is an innovative research work that aims to address concerns regarding the transmission of diseases similar to COVID-19 and enable individuals to safely engage in religious practices. By employing Arduino UNO R3 and ESP8266 boards, this work presents a distinctive solution that allows individuals to ring temple bells without the need for physical contact. The system incorporates an ultrasonic sensor that is connected to one of the ESP8266 boards. This sensor effectively detects individuals within a specific distance range. By establishing a Wi-Fi connection between two ES P8266 boards, the ultrasonic sensor transmits a message to a relay connected to the Arduino UNO. Consequently, the relay activates a motor, which, in turn, triggers the ringing of the temple bell in an automated fashion. Through this contactless approach, the system effectively eliminates the necessity for individuals to physically touch the temple bell, thereby significantly reducing the risk of disease transmission within public spaces. By leveraging the power of IoT technology, this system ensures that individuals can fulfill their religious obligations without any constraints while simultaneously prioritizing their safety. This research serves as a testament to the remarkable potential of IoT in effectively mitigating the challenges posed by the pandemic and facilitating safer religious practices. It exemplifies technology's ability to adapt to and overcome public health crises, presenting innovative solutions that empower individuals to continue their devotional activities in a completely contactless manner.

articleTitle: QVD-Querying Video Databases for Event Related Frames Using Text Keywords
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: With increasing camera enabled devices huge video data is generated every second. With unlimited storage offered by cloud, most of this video data is moved to cloud storage directly or indirectly. But manually querying such a huge data is challenging for most of the people. We have proposed an indexing method where from tokens of query we can find related frames and videos in a short amount of time. Queries could be very specific e.g. “car accident in area * at time*” Thus video summarization is used to produce short summary of long videos. Manually checking these summaries is again challenging task. This work aims to generate algorithm to query any video database in fraction of time, with few keywords related to video. Aim of generating a comprehensive algorithm is achieved by creating summary of each video. And the aim is also to achieve to Generate caption for each frame and then generating cumulative summary from summarized video frames using LSTM. This is achieved by searching user keywords in these summaries and ranking related summaries using CNN.

articleTitle: Independent Wireless Networking System for Environmental Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: This study enunciates the construction of an electronic system for detecting and monitoring environmental conditions such as landslides, rock falls, flooding etc. The constructed system is totally independent and autonomous because of implementation of a wireless sensor network. The nodes of wireless sensor network can be either configured by user or by automation. Hence it becomes easier for constructing the network. The sensor node is constructed using a typical microcontroller along with a Radio communication unit. The collected information is correlated with parameters such as position, speed, inclination and temperature of all nodes in a consistent manner. This information is transmitted and maintained in a web server at remote which can be used for consultation of data later.

articleTitle: Automated Human Emotion Recognition from Speech Using Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Automated speech emotion detection is a challenging procedure due to the discrepancy between acoustic features and human emotions, which heavily depends on the discriminative acoustic characteristics obtained for a given recognition job. Individuals have several unique ways to communicate their emotions. As a result, one of the challenging tasks in computational vision is speech emotion detection. In this case, Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) method recognizes the vocal emotion. Classifiers are utilized in the CNN algorithm's multiple emotion identification modules to discriminate various emotions like happiness, surprise, rage, sorrow, etc.

articleTitle: Performance Enhancement to Improve Accuracy for the Novel CNN GoogleNet Compared AAgainst ResNet in Predicting Cyber Hacking Breaches
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: The aim of this research is to predict cyber hacking breaches by using the two machine learning algorithms Novel CNN Google Net and ResNet algorithms. Materials and Methods: Novel CNN Google Net and ResNet are used in this work to predict the cyber hacking breaches with varying training and testing splits. There are 2030 cyber hacking breach images collected for this research study from an open source Kaggle web resource. The datasets were split into two train dataset and test dataset. The train data set consists of 1624 images and test data consists of 406 data set images. The information has been gathered from various web resources. The G-Power test utilized approximately 80% of the G-Power setting parameters with <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\boldsymbol{\alpha}=\mathbf{0.05}$</tex> and power=0.80. The experiment study was iterated twenty times using the above said models. Result and discussion: This research paper found the Novel CNN Google Net 93.40% has the increased accuracy over ResNet 92.05%. The Independent Sample T-test showed statistical significance at the 95% confidence interval with a p-value of 0.001 <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(\mathbf{p} < \mathbf{0.05})$</tex>. This indicates a significant difference between the two groups. Conclusion: Machine learning algorithms are used in the study paper. both. Novel CNN GoogleNet and the ResNet algorithm. Accuracy comparison of GoogleNet compared over ResNet in predicting cyber hacking breaches in the early stage.

articleTitle: AQUASENSE: Sensor Based Water Quality Monitoring Device
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Water is an essential part of living organisms. The Industrialization has caused immense contamination of potable water. Hence water quality monitors play an important role in detection of contamination in these water bodies. There are many water quality monitors available in the market for the detection of level of contamination. This research study discusses about the effective usage of Arduino UNO board, sensors to measure temperature, TDS and pH to measure the water quality. Hence, the main aim of this research study is to find the TDS, temperature and pH of the water samples collected from various places in Bangalore City, Karnataka, and conclude regarding the quality of the water whether it is portable to use for drinking and domestic purpose.

articleTitle: Real-Time Monitoring System for Transformer Using IoT
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: The design and implementation of an IoT system to measure an overvoltage is suggested in this research study. The Internet of Things (IoT), a single-chip Arduino, and sensors are used to construct this online measuring system. It is situated at the location of the distribution transformer. The system memory processes and stores the sensor output values. The system is preprogrammed to check for a normal condition utilizing some specified commands. If there is a problem with the system, information is automatically updated online via serial transmission. By utilizing the Internet of Things (IoT), utilities will be able to use transformers to their full potential and quickly pinpoint issues in the event of a failure. As a result, the voltage data is collected and analyzed using an online evaluation system. IoT is used to store every value in the system. Therefore, the transformer's Real-time Measuring will assist in identifying unforeseen circumstances when any failure occurs, increasing dependability and substantially lowering costs. The stability, accuracy, and efficiency of the transformer can all be improved by this technology. The Real-Time Transformer Monitoring System Using IoT project offers continuous tracking, early fault detection, and predictive maintenance capabilities, which have the potential to greatly improve power distribution infrastructure. By using this cutting-edge system, transformers should become more dependable, efficient, and resilient, which will help create a more stable and long-term power distribution network.

articleTitle: Real-Time Environmental Noise Management and Control Using Raspberry Pi and Acoustic Sensors
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Urban noise pollution threatens health and quality of life. This paper proposes real-time ambient noise management using acoustic sensors and a Raspberry Pi. A cost-efficient and effective noise monitoring and reduction system is the aim. The system's CPU is a Raspberry Pi. To detect noise, acoustic sensors are strategically placed. The Raspberry Pi processes sensor data in real-time and analyzes noise to gain insights. The system measures noise using FFT and noise mapping techniques. These approaches allow us to fully understand noise's properties and geographical distribution and the fundamental elements derived from acoustic data. Based on noise analysis, active control methods decrease noise pollution. This includes sound masking, adaptive noise cancellation, and intelligent activity scheduling. The Raspberry Pi makes noise control techniques easier to organize and implement. The suggested system is extensively tested in real-world conditions. Our technique successfully reduces noise pollution, identifies noise sources, and properly measures noise levels. Real-time reaction and intervention improve environmental and noise control. This research helps create a cost-effective real-time environmental noise control system. Combining the Raspberry Pi with sound sensors creates a flexible platform that may be deployed in homes, offices, and public spaces. The system's real-time noise data analysis and active noise control offer new noise management solutions.

articleTitle: Seven Level Parallel Inverter for Wind, PV, Battery based Hybrid Standalone System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Electric power generation through hybrid renewable energy sources is a best solution for solution of many problems. In order to achieve the best performance of the model, a multilevel inverter must be incorporated between dc-link and load bus. However, multilevel inverters are suffering with high number of switches. Hence, a closed loop control method of a seven level parallel multilevel inverter is implemented in this paper to improve the power quality. PMSG coupled wind power conversion system, PV and battery operated standalone system is considered in this paper. The proposed parallel multilevel topology required only half number of switches compared to existing basic topologies. A new SPWM method is implemented in this paper to generate the required pulses to the inverter. The hardware-in-loop (HIL) is implemented to analyze the response of the system under various operating conditions with the help of OPAL-RT devices.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Web Application for Chronic Kidney Disease Prediction with Cuisine-Centric Diet Recommendation
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Despite advancements in detection and treatment, there exists a critical gap in patient care-post-diagnosis guidance and support. In response to this challenge, our proposed work presents a novel integrated system designed to guide and empower CKD patients towards a healthier and more fulfilling life. The proposed work aims at creating an integrated system for the early detection of chronic kidney disease (CKD) using Machine Learning technology, a diet recommender for the prevention of disease from further development. The model output is integrated with the Flask framework and the front end, which is developed in HTML (includes Java Script) is used to receive user input on various parameters needed to decide on the early detection of kidney disease. This model is deployed into the IBM cloud using API keys and scoring endpoints. The chronic kidney disease prediction and diet recommendations are displayed in a Kidney Guard web application that has multiple user-engagement features such as a motivator chatbot, homemade paradise hub (for homemade recipes), prediction history, calorie recorded and burnt, soul stretch (for yoga) and sweat spot (for exercise). This work enables doctors in the early detection of CKD and cuisine-centric diet recommendation helps the users to adhere to the dietary and lifestyle changes which are holistic components in the prevention and management of CKD.

articleTitle: Enhancing Grid Connectivity with a Double-Stage PV System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: This research work focuses on the proper utilization of electricity from a photovoltaic (PV) system with a grid connection. There are no issues when the PV system and grid are connected appropriately. However, any mismatch between them can lead to severe problems. The project aims to address these challenges by employing a multilevel inverter and LC filters to ensure a proper connection between the grid and the PV system. Additionally, the project uses a boost converter to enhance the efficiency of the DC output voltage from the PV modules. Furthermore, the application of sinusoidal PWM techniques to the inverter is expected to yield efficient results.

articleTitle: Efficient Automation of Web Application Development and Deployment Using Jenkins: A Comprehensive CI/CD Pipeline for Enhanced Productivity and Quality
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Nowadays software developers are building web applications, to the main requirement is that it work well, be free from issues and reach users quickly. But doing this can be challenging. That is where Continuous Integration (CI) and Continuous Deployment (CD) come with a concept called Jenkins. It has become a vital tool for software developers globally because of automation. This research study explores the impact of Jenkins automation on improving web application development by automating essential tasks like testing and deployment. It also examines notable benefits such as early issue detection, increased developer focus, time savings, and enhanced reliability. Through a practical example using the Angular framework for web applications, this study underscores the considerable benefits of integrating Jenkins automation. Overall, this research highlights the importance of Jenkins in enhancing software development processes, making them more efficient and effective.

articleTitle: Enhancing Skin Cancer Diagnosis Using DL with 3D Model
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Skin cancer is a potentially fatal condition that can be treated if found in its early stages. The diagnosis of skin cancer is often challenging and requires skilled medical professionals. Deep learning models have shown promise in detecting skin cancer from images with high accuracy. The proposed neural network using convolutions is to identify skin cancer using photos of skin lesions. The model was evaluated on a different dataset of 5,105 photos after being trained on a dataset of over 10,000 images. It is also developed a web-based application that allows users to upload their skin lesion images to the model and obtain a prediction of the cancer type. The output is a cancer type with a 3D image of the skin lesion that can aid in visualizing the extent of the cancer. The results show that the model achieved an accuracy of 94%, This performs better than earlier state-of-the-art techniques. The proposed web-based application offers a simple method for spotting skin cancer early on.

articleTitle: Linearity Analysis of Charge Plasma-Induced Graded Channel Nanotube at Varying Temperatures
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Silicon-based Graded Channel Nanotube MOSFET (GC-NTFET) has been analyzed for the change its surrounding temperature brings in its linearity performance. In this research study, Linearity FoMs such as high-order gm, Harmonic Distortion of second-third order HD2 &HD3, Third Order Current Intercept Point (IIP3), third order Inter-modulation Distortion (IMD3), Higher Order Voltage Intercept Points (VIP2 & VIP3), etc has been analyzed for a wide range of temperature extending from 250K to 500K using ATLAS 3D TCAD device simulation tool. The performance assessment reveals that the proposed device offers superior linearity at higher temperature ranges owing to reduced distortions.

articleTitle: Design and Fabrication of Smart Inspection System for Industrial Products Using ML Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Industrial 4.0 is revolutionizing the world including robotics, nanotechnologies etc., Still detecting defects on parts has a significant challenge to solve. The manufacturing factories and distribution centres have complex technologies for inspection of the products and packaging process. Especially the food and clothing industries have to deeply investigate the defects. Conventional inspection systems implement physical inspection techniques to find defects in the product which may have a chance to affect the final product. In some test methods only relatively non-porous surfaces can be inspected and in some cases, this can be affected by variations in magnetic permeability. A well-achieved visual inspection provides a reduction in the amount of repairs and overcomes the above-mentioned problems in the inspection system. By simply presenting the inspection system with several model images, deep learning enables it to learn to detect surface anomalies. The device which works on the concept of Deep Learning based image analysis for factory automation is our proposed theme. To train the machine, sample image sets are given. This can be made customized as data sheets are given to the software. Hence, the proposed system can be customizable according to the product dimensions.

articleTitle: Data Ingestion - Cloud based Ingestion Analysis using NiFi
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Data Ingestion has been an integral part of Data Analysis. Bringing the data from various heterogeneous sources to one common place and ensuring the data is captured in the appropriate format is the key for performing any Big data task. Data ingestion is performed using multiple frameworks across the industry and they all have their own set of benefits and drawbacks. Apache NiFi is one popular ingestion framework which is used widely and does Ingestion effectively. Ingestion is performed on various sources and the data is generally stored in clusters or cloud storage. In this paper, we have done the File Data Ingestion using the NiFi framework on a local machine and then on two cloud-based platforms, namely Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and Amazon Web Services (AWS). The objective is to understand the latency and performance of the NiFi tool on Cloud-based Ingestion and provide a comparative study against the typical Data Ingestion. The entire setup was done on a local machine and two corresponding cloud platforms namely GCP and AWS. The findings from the comparative analysis have been compiled in a tabular format and graphs are created for easy reference. The paper places emphasis on the significance of NiFi's data ingestion performance on Cloud Platform and attempts to present it as a major activity on the data ingestion platform for Cloud Ingestion Solution.

articleTitle: IoMT-Enabled Wearable Sensors for Continuous Glucose Monitoring in Diabetes Management
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: The research study presents a comprehensive overview on the utilization of IoMT-enabled wearable sensors for continuous glucose monitoring in diabetes management. The introduction emphasizes the criticality of glucose monitoring in effective diabetes care and outlines the limitations of existing monitoring methods. The problem statement highlights the need for real-time and continuous monitoring to enable proactive interventions and better management of glucose levels. The proposed work introduces a novel solution that integrates wearable sensors and IoMT technologies to enable seamless and accurate monitoring of glucose levels. The experimental results demonstrate the efficacy of the proposed approach in providing reliable glucose measurements and timely alerts. In conclusion, the integration of IoMT-enabled wearable sensors holds significant potential in revolutionizing diabetes management, facilitating personalized care, and improving patient outcomes.

articleTitle: Text Document Clustering Using the Hybrid Fruit Fly Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: The Internet produces vast amounts of text data, expanding quickly. The abundance of text data in the unstructured format makes it difficult to extract and analyze the pertinent data. A text-mining technique called text document clustering separates text-based documents into completely independent groupings; consider likenesses between documents inside a group while simultaneously considering fluctuations in happiness between documents from various clusters. Partitioning the variety of text data by evaluating the practicality of the data in the documents is one of the issues tested in text clustering.

articleTitle: A Novel Technique for Handwritten Text Recognition Using Easy OCR
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Among computer vision's many new subfields, character recognition is one of the most promising. Humans' superior recognition skills make them the most powerful species. Humans have little trouble deciphering the hand transcription. There are distinct patterns to look for in various languages. The text is easily recognizable by humans. The machine cannot recognize the manual transcription. The system needs help recognizing the text. Processing the input image, extracting features, and training a classification schema are all part of the text recognition process. The computer is taught to look for similarities and differences between different handwriting samples in this method. The program reads a picture of a handwritten transcript and creates an electronic version. Today, cutting-edge scientific methods expand humanity's horizons in all technological endeavors. Character recognition, often known as OCR (Optical Character Recognition), is one example of such a field. The approach presented here is built on EasyOCR and Regular Expressions, which facilitate exporting trip sheet information to CSV. The suggested model divides the image into many boxes based on the intersection of lines and then looks for individual characters within each box. Recognized texts are saved independently, allowing for format conversion at a later date. Unlike other types of OCR (Optical Character Recognition), which focus on recognizing characters generated by a computer or typewriter, this project focuses on developing an algorithm for recognizing handwritten characters, commonly known as HCR (Handwritten Character Recognition). An innovative method, based on Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) and including character feature extraction approaches, is proposed for recognizing English language characters. Over 90% of the time, CNN correctly identified the characters being shown.

articleTitle: Enhancing Shopping Experience with Raspberry Pi and Cloud-Integrated Wireless Sensor Networks for Smart Trolleys in IoT
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Rapid advances in Internet of Things (IoT) technology have opened new doors for retail and other businesses. The system suggests using Raspberry Pi and cloud-integrated wireless sensor networks to construct smart trolleys to improve shopping. Traditional shopping experiences without real-time product availability, price, and tailored suggestions cause inefficiencies and customer discontent. Our approach incorporates IoT-enabled technology into shopping carts and gives them intelligence and connection. Our concept involves integrating wireless sensor networks into the retail experience with a Raspberry Pi. Raspberry Pi is the smart trolley's cloud hub. This allows information exchange, observation, and smart independent direction. Our system uses the cloud basis to acquire and manage stock data sets, client profiles, and continual sensor input to tailor shopping experiences. Advanced data analytics produce individualized suggestions, alert customers about product availability, and deliver targeted discounts based on a customer's tastes and prior data. Smart trolley wireless sensors provide automated item recognition, amount tracking, and real-time perishable commodities monitoring. This ensures accurate billing, shortens checkout, and reduces stockout risk. The system is extensively tested and evaluated our suggested system's efficiency and efficacy. Sales increased, shopping times decreased, and customer happiness increased. Our solution's flexibility also considers easy retail framework integration. This research study gives a complete framework for improving shopping with Raspberry Pi and cloud-integrated wireless sensor networks for smart trolleys in the Internet of Things. The solution overcomes conventional shopping system difficulties, creating a more customized, efficient, and engaging retail environment.

articleTitle: Fractional Order Lowpass Filter Realization Using M-SBL Method
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Several different research teams have recently started to demonstrate a strong interest in the topic of fractional-order circuits. A brand new approach to constructing fractional order low-pass filters (FOLPF) is detailed in this body of work. Finding a rational approximation of the fractional laplace operator <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$s^{\alpha}$</tex> is one of the most critical tasks in the process of creating fractional order filters. Comparison is made between the Continued Fraction Expansion method and the M-SBL approach, which are two of the most common approaches for approximating values. After that, the transfer function of the suggested FOLPF is figured out. After that, an operational amplifier is utilised in order to generate the indicated filter. A simulation of the suggested circuit is performed with the assistance of Texas Instruments' TINA Software. The results are far better than those achieved by the methods that are currently in use.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Network Based 6G Framework for Healthcare Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: The architecture of 6G technique can be exploited for combining various applications of network to provide consistent communication of data within the nodes. This technique offers excellent features and improved facilities for optimum operations. A fuzzy network based 6G framework is presented in order to provide Hospital to Home (H2H) services in place of ambulance services. In the coming days, vehicles will be manufactured in an intelligent way with help of AI. H2H will be promoted with an intelligent and smart vehicle having less amount of dependence on hospitals. Thus mobile hospital can track any sort of emergency environment and rush to the place for saving human beings. This approach can improve the lifestyle in these modern days. This study enunciates the evolution of 6G communication on modern lifestyles by means of H2H services. Hence patients can be treated well in advance before going to hospitals.

articleTitle: Appropriate Order of Feature Selection Techniques Selection based on Filter and Wrapper Approaches
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Numerous fields, including the classification of spam emails, cancer cells, fraudulent claims, credit risk, text categorization, and DNA microarray analysis, have extensively used feature selection. However, one of the most significant applications of feature selection technique is in cancer diagnosis through gene expression data. With many genes but few samples, microarray data is a high-dimensional dataset. The purpose of feature selection is to determine how few characteristics are required to provide high classification accuracy. A crucial stage in the analysis of microarray data is feature selection, which lowers the data's dimensionality and boosts the effectiveness of the models. Building predictive models for classification includes predicting the target variable using a variety of input variables (features). This study looks at the best way to apply the filter and wrapper techniques to improve classification results. The computation uses three filters and one wrapper technique, and the results are reported using four performance measures. Three microarray cancer data are used throughout the entire trial. The result analysis shows the order of feature selection in terms of filter and then wrapper techniques outperform.

articleTitle: Detection of Sensors Fault Using Singular Value Decomposition Technique in Power Plant
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Temperature sensors are critical components in power plants, and their accurate operation is essential for efficient plant performance and safety. However, temperature sensors are susceptible to various faults such as offset, and sensor failure, which can lead to incorrect temperature readings and affect the overall plant operation. Therefore, it is crucial to detect and diagnose temperature sensor faults to secure the safety and dependability of the plant. Integrating machine learning methods into existing sensor systems for fault detection poses significant challenges. Seamless integration with data acquisition systems and sensor networks is essential but can be complex due to differences in data formats and communication protocols. Real-time processing requirements may necessitate optimization for low latency. Ensuring that machine learning models run efficiently on embedded, or edge devices can also be challenging. Furthermore, integrating the output of machine learning models into decision-making processes or control systems requires careful consideration to prevent false alarms or missed faults. This study proposes the implementation of Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) for detecting sensor faults using Lab View.This method utilizes SVD to extract feature vectors from sensor data, which are then compared to reference vectors to identify faulty sensors. The Lab Viewplatform is used to develop the software application for processing the sensor data and performing the SVD analysis. The proposed method offers a reliable and efficient approach to detecting sensor faults in industrial systems, potentially improving system reliability and reducing downtime.

articleTitle: NEWSMO: A Computer-Aided News Classification Model from Tweets Topic Using a Modified Passive Aggressive and Pipeline Classifier
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: In the current technology, wherein the internet is wall-to-wall, all of us are predicated on diverse online assets for information. Fake information in recent times is a crucial factor in the existence of social media and the political world. Fake information detection is a crucial study to be carried out for its detection; however, it also has a few demanding situations. Some demanding situations may be because of a much smaller range of assets, such as finding datasets and posted literature. This paper's findings show that the proposed model has achieved various accuracies and comparisons on many machine learning algorithms. The proposed model goal is to allow the user to determine if the information is authentic or fraudulent. Due to a lack of supporting data or assertions, fake news frequently relates to recent, urgent occurrences that existing knowledge sources may not have fully confirmed. The proposed model has utilized a publicly available Kaggle and UCI dataset and modified it to match the current data. It comprises 1856 articles divided into six categories: State, satire, bias, conspiracy, hate, and fake science. The dataset is divided into 371 records for testing and 1485 records for training. The model included modified passive aggressive and pipeline classifiers with 99.6% and 98.9% accuracy, respectively. The objective is to create a system that can correctly categorize news stories that have never been viewed.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-Based Multistep Forecasting for Photovoltaic Power Generation: A Comprehensive Comparative Study
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Electrical energy being the major contributor to the industrial revolution that has impacted social and economic growth has become an essential part of human life. The shift from finite, non-renewable power sources to sustainable, renewable options has been a significant consciousness within the power quarter. Solar energy is the most effective and common renewable energy resource. This study proposes an effective model to predict solar energy 24 hour ahead based on weather forecasts for successful integration into solar grids. Deep learning algorithms such as LSTM, Bidirectional LSTM BI-LSTM and GRU are implemented for energy prediction. To measure the model performance Quadratic Mean Error (QME i.e., MSE), Mean absolute deviation (MAD ie., MAE), Quadratic mean squared error (QMSE ie., RMSE) and R2-Score. Prediction using LSTM, BI-LSTM and GRU yielded R2-score error of 0.932, 0.930 & 0.919 respectively. Based on the results the LSTM provided a robust model for predicting 24 hr. ahead solar power.

articleTitle: An Advanced Cloud Security and Load Balancing in Health Care Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Healthcare systems increasingly use cloud computing technologies to improve operational efficiency and patient care. However, due to the sensitive nature of healthcare data and the importance of uninterrupted service, cloud-based healthcare environments require robust security measures and effective load-balancing mechanisms. This paper provides advanced load balancing (ALB) with high-level security (HLS), which offers advanced cloud security and load-balancing techniques for healthcare systems. This abstract focuses on three critical aspects of cloud security: data protection, access control, and threat detection and response. Cutting-edge encryption algorithms and secure transmission protocols protect patient records, medical images, and other sensitive data. Access control mechanisms such as role-based access control and multi-factor authentication are implemented to ensure authorized access to healthcare resources and prevent unauthorized breaches. Load balancing is critical in healthcare systems to ensure high availability and optimal resource utilization. This abstract discusses load-balancing strategies that are designed explicitly for healthcare workloads. Incoming requests are distributed across multiple servers using dynamic load-balancing algorithms, preventing any single node from overloading and ensuring efficient resource utilization. In addition, the abstract emphasizes the incorporation of cloud security and load-balancing mechanisms in healthcare systems. By combining these two factors, healthcare organizations can create a secure and scalable infrastructure that can provide continuous services to patients, healthcare professionals, and other stakeholders. The abstract emphasizes the importance of constant monitoring, proactive maintenance, and regular updates to ensure the effectiveness of security and load-balancing measures in an evolving cloud environment.

articleTitle: Radio Astronomy Based S-Band Horn Antenna for CubeSat Application
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: The CubeSat is commonly used for low earth orbit for remote sensing and communication cube sat with 9 cm X 9cm are used in solar cell to convert the solar light which is stored in lithium- ion battery. The radio as tronomy is a sub field of the as tronomy that identifies the celestial object at radio frequency. The s-band frequency range of 5 GHz and wavelength of 1500nm is used to design horn antenna. Horn antenna is used in high - speed and inter -satellite links where high data rates are favored which is used to transmit bulk data. It is also used for remote sensing applications. Design and simulation of horn antenna which works at micro wave domain starts at frequency of 3GHZ, to improve the antenna medium gain. Pyramidal horn antenna is used and designed in the frequency of 5GHZ. When the same antenna is designed Changing with frequency of 10GHz and 15GHz Gain, Directivity value and Efficiency are improved From the results, VSWR value is reduced when the frequency is increased It shows that, by using horn antenna, the amount of reflection can be reduced While increasing the amount of radiated efficiency, powers radiated by an antenna to the power fed in the antenna's excitation port ratios are determined.

articleTitle: Concentrated Solar Water Heater Using Parabolic Trough
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Energy will always remain the cornerstone for the advancement of human society, regardless of how the world changes in the future. Recently, there has been a tremendous increase in the need for renewable energy sources. Electric power produced from renewable sources could provide 65 per cent of the world's total electricity needs. “All the energy needed for a year can be provided by the sun in just one hour”. To be extremely beneficial and environmentally safe, solar energy is the best source. However the current solar panels produce electric power only during the sunny days effectively, but not in the winter and cloudy days In order to overcome the limitations of solar panels, the concept of concentrated solar power comes to the rescue. Concentrated Solar Power (CSP) uses a mirror or concave lens to cover a large area of sunlight into a receiver to produce power at a high-efficiency rate. It consists of a parabolic-shaped cylinder concentrator and a circular cylindrical receiver that are both placed along the parabola's focus line. The main advantage of this system is thermal energy storage, which can store heat or cold at different temperature conditions. Light is focused onto a focal point using parabolic mirrors or heliostats. The Temperature at the focal point may reach 3,500°C (i.e.) 6,330°F, and this heat can melt steel, produce energy, produce hydrogen fuel, or create nanomaterials. The purpose of the proposed system is to provide feed water for the boiler.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Control Algorithm in IoT-Based PV System for Dual Power Applications
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: The potential of clean energy sources to lessen environmental consequences and cut down on dependability on fossil fuels has contributed to their rise in popularity. Photovoltaic (PV) systems are often utilized to generate power since they are environmentally friendly and reliable. When various power outputs are needed, dual-power PV systems that offer both direct current (DC) and alternating current (AC) power are suitable. However, it is difficult to build an effective and dependable system of control for such systems. A fuzzy control approach for an interleaved boost converter (IBC) in a dual-power PV system is presented. Internet of Things (IoT) technology allows for better control and monitoring of the suggested system. It is shown that a fuzzy logic controller (FLC) may enhance the system's productivity, stability, and resilience by comparing the fuzzy controller's performance to those of conventional proportional integral derivative (PID) and proportional-integral (PI) controllers. By improved stability and performance in dynamic environments, results indicate that fuzzy logic may be a viable alternative to conventional controllers. Several types of renewable energy systems may benefit from the described method since it allows for dual-power applications with enhanced control and monitoring.

Author Keywords: Proportional integral derivative control and Dual power applications

articleTitle: A Method to Remove a Welding Slag Using Welding Slag Removing Machine
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Slag is a fused material that forms during melting and is composed of metal oxides and silicon dioxide. In the past, slag removal required manual labor using a chipping hammer, which was time-consuming and required a high level of physical exertion. To overcome these problems, the paragraph suggests the use of an alternative technique-an efficient slag removal machine with a simple construction. The main component of this machine is a wire brush, which is mounted on the shaft ofa motor. When the motor runs, the wire brush rotates. The job material, which has slag on it, is placed under the wire brush.As the wire brush rotates and hits the job material, it effectively removes a significant amount of slag. This mechanical method of slag removal is much faster and more efficient compared to the manual process. It reduces the need for manual labor, decreases work pressure, and saves time. The key advantage of this machineis its cost efficiency. The simple construction of the machine, centered around a wire brush and a motor, makes it a cost- effective solution for slag removal. By automating the process, it eliminates the need for manual labor and increases productivity. Based on these benefits, the paragraph concludes by suggesting that in the future, this slag removal machine will be available anywhere. This implies that the machine has the potential to become widely adopted in various industries that involve slag removal, as it offers a simple and efficient solution to a labor- intensive and time-consuming task.

articleTitle: Enhanced Communication Through Isolated Sign Language
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Isolated sign language recognition is a vital area of research that aims to bridge the communication gap between the hearing-impaired community and the general population. Sign language is the main medium of communication for the deaf and dumb persons. Isolated sign language is a useful and important communication method, breaking barriers, and promoting inclusion in various aspects of daily life for the deaf and hearing-impaired communities. The GISL (Google Isolated Sign Language) comprises a wide range of isolated sign language gestures performed by individuals from different cultural backgrounds. The dataset is annotated with corresponding labels to facilitate supervised learning algorithms. The dataset consists of recorded video samples of human gestures which resembles the communication through human actions. To evaluate the performance of the model, accuracy is computed to assess the model's performance in recognizing isolated sign language gestures. The model is also tested for real-time processing capabilities, ensuring its usability in practical scenarios.

articleTitle: Real Time Attendance Entry Using Face Detection and Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: The human face is the feature that most clearly identifies a person. The face recognition system can be developed using facial traits as a biometric. The most difficult task is frequently keeping track of attendance. While taking attendance traditionally, teachers call the pupils forward and accurately note whether they are there or not. Yet, these conventional methods require a lot of time and effort. The Open CV-based facial recognition approach has been put out in this work. An input image is captured by a camera followed by which the chosen algorithm of Local Binary Pattern Histogram undergoes a testing phase to perform face detection followed by face identification and thus performing attendance logging in real time meeting many real time applications.

articleTitle: High Tech Vehicle Security Structure Based on PIC Using GPS and GSM
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Concerns have been raised about security, specifically theft security of vehicles in public parking lots. Using embedded system which is integrated into the GPS and the GSM Communication, an achievement automobile security system is built to locate the car. Proposed method is to establish a smart system that employs GPS and GSM technology to pinpoint a car precisely and deter theft. Using GPS, you can track where you are right now. There are two different kinds of tracking methods adopted for vehicles: online tracking and offline monitoring. Because a GPS system can only receive information about a car's location from satellites, a GSM system is also placed in the vehicle to convey information to the owner of the vehicle. The low-range automobiles were taken along when designing the entire system, which offers them the utmost protection and aids in helping the owner locate the vehicle.

articleTitle: Vision Transformer in Oral Cancer Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Oral cancer is a malignancy that can manifest in multiple areas of the mouth, including the tongue, lips, oral mucosa, gums, floor of the mouth, and other soft tissues. Despite the development of advanced diagnostic and therapeutic methods, the incidence and prevalence of oral cancer continue to be a cause for concern. This condition can have devastating effects on patients, including significant physical and emotional distress. Detecting oral cancer at an early stage can improve a patient's chances of survival and reduce the need for aggressive treatment. In recent years, machine learning techniques have demonstrated promising results in the detection of oral cancer. This research aims to explore the role of vision transformers in oral cancer classification as benign and malignant. The results obtained from the vision transformer are compared with Machine learning techniques like SVM, extreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost), and Random Forest. Overall, the results show that ViT outperformed SVM, Random Forest, and XGBoost in oral cancer detection and stage classification with an accuracy of 96.7%. The accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score of ViT are higher than other methods. The findings of the research show that all four machine learning methods examined can produce high precision rates in detecting oral cancer, with the Vision Transformer technique achieving superior results as vision transformers are designed to capture global context information in images. The proposed system has great potential to advance the precision and efficiency of oral cancer diagnosis, which can lead to more prompt and effective treatment.

articleTitle: Neural Network-based Real-Time Recognition of American Sign Language Finger-Spelled Gestures: Bridging Communication Gaps
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: In this work, an innovative solution addresses the limitations of sign language communication, arising from a lack of familiarity and interpreter availability, by leveraging advanced neural networks for real-time recognition of finger-spelled gestures in American Sign Language. This approach bridges the communication gap by providing a means to decode sign language gestures, regardless of the user's familiarity with sign language, through a two-step process involving gesture refinement and classification. The ultimate objective is to create a model capable of seamlessly translating live video feeds of American Sign Language hand gestures into on-screen text representations of specific signs. Notably, our meticulously trained CNN classifierachieves an impressive 95.7<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup> accuracy in recognizing 27 symbols, including the 26 English alphabets and a ‘blank’ symbol usedfor sentence spacing.

articleTitle: High-Capacity, A Secret Video Sharing Using DM-Stego and Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Electronic media knowledge is unprecedently increasing in recent years. In almost all security control areas, traffic control, weather monitoring, video conferences, social media etc., videos and multimedia data analysis practices are used. As a consequence, it is necessary to retain and transmit these data, by considering the security and privacy issues. IN this research study, a new Div-Mod Stego algorithm is combined with the Multi-Secret Sharing method along with temporary frame reordering and Genetic algorithm to implement high-end security in the process of video sharing. The qualitative and quantitative analysis has also been carried out to compare the performance of the proposed model with the other existing models. A computer analysis shows that the proposed solution would satisfy the requirements of the real-time application.

articleTitle: Real Time Data Based Boiler Temperature Management System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: A Real time data based system for managing boiler temperature is described in this work. It is intended to track and manage boiler temperature in real-time. The MCU, an ultrasonic sensor, an OLED display, a servo motor, and temperature sensors that are mounted within the boiler to make up the system. The Node-MCU processes the data once it has been processed by the temperature sensors and display the results in real-time. The program in Node-MCU will analyzes the information and produces reports that can be used to spot potential boiler temperature problems in real-time. In order to ensure effective and secure operation, the control system uses the temperature data from the temperature sensor to regulate the boiler temperature in real-time. To ensure quick maintenance and repairs, the proposed system will provide alerts in the display which will be intimated to the boiler operator. An effective and secure method of managing boiler temperature is provided by the Real time data based system. This technique will contribute to improve boiler safety, increased efficiency, and decreased energy usage. The system can be quickly adapted to meet the unique requirements of an application and is easily expandable. Overall, the system may contribute to the boiler system's efficient and secure operation.

articleTitle: A Novel Time Resource Allocation Configuration for Multi-Task Offloading in Mobile Cloud Computing (MCC)
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: The main objective of this research study revolves around reducing remote cloud communication latency and alleviating system load through the implementation of a ‘cloudlet.’ However, it is important to acknowledge that while cloudlets offer advantages in reducing communication delays, matching the formidable system performance of remote clouds fall short in terms. The cloud dynamically allocates resources to cater to the changing user population, but the vulnerability of cloudlet services leads to interruptions in user access during task execution. Consequently, this renders cloud computing ineffective, as users fail to receive the expected computational outcomes. In response to these challenges, this article introduces a comprehensive framework for real-time resource allocation, enabling users to efficiently distribute essential resources. To overcome issues related to task failures and real-time resource allocation, the paper recommends the adoption of the Particle Swarm Optimization-Motion Log (PSO-ML) method. Remarkably, the PSO-ML method surpasses the traditional PSO method in terms of delivering more robust and impactful results. Keywords: MCC, PSO-ML, PSO, Assets allocation, Task Offloading

articleTitle: Customer Perception on Online Cosmetic Product Purchases Using Association Rule Mining Based on Customer Feedback
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: For the past few years, consumers have changed their way of shopping. Nowadays people are more interested in online shopping than traditional style of shopping. As many companies turned their mode of marketing their product from normal brick shops to online platforms, where customers feel free to shop. Be it hardware, basic food item, attire and footwear industry or for that reality even the drug business, every one of them have been exceptionally inviting to use this means to acquire an edge as far as client securing and driving their deals. Whether it is online shopping or real time physical shopping, customer perception about a particular brand or a product will affect the purchase plan of the consumer. In this current competitive environment many companies try to sell different types of goods in order to retain the company's market as well as to retain and to attract the customers. In order to retain customers every company must understand their customer's perception about their product. Cosmetic products play a vital role in day to day activities of modern girls and women. In this study, customer perception towards buying cosmetic products through online was analyzed using association rule mining to find the relation that lies between feedbacks regarding the products purchased.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Convolutional Neural Network Model and Various Machine Learning Models for Decision-Making in the Health Care Industry
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Numerous diseases nowadays should be recognized from the get-go to start viable treatments. If not, they may be lethal and incurable. Thus, it is important to examine convoluted clinical information, reports, and photos quicker while maintaining a more significant precision level. In different cases., certain peculiarities are unpretentious to such an extent that individuals can't promptly distinguish them. At the point when a basic information examination on clinical information is expected to distinguish stowed-away connections or irregularities that are not obvious to people, AI innovations are being utilized in medical services for computational navigation. It is trying to execute algorithms to do such positions in any of them, yet it is considerably harder to develop calculation precision further while decreasing execution time. The meaning of preventive and productive medical services utilizing enormous information scattered through different loT gadgets is underlined in medical care and IT because of the late expanded interest. Medical care data investigation fundamentally includes forecast by utilizing a client's essential data and static information from a knowledge base. This research study proposes a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) and machine learning-based unique model for health care predictions.

articleTitle: Design and Development of a System to Control and Monitor the Atmospheric CO and CO2 in Traffic Junctions Using IoT
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: At present time, air pollution leads to many critical challenges. The equilibrium of the natural environment has been distressed by human activities such as rapid industrialization, quick urbanization, rapid population expansion, dramatic increases in the number of automobiles on the road, and other activities. It alters the climate's quality and change in the climate is a result of the build-up of atmospheric concentrations of greenhouse gases. Global warming brought on by greenhouse gas emissions is one of the biggest environmental issues in our planet. A vital environmental component called carbon dioxide is warming the surface of the world. It is a difficult task to monitor and manage these changes in order to preserve our ecosystem. A more desired and efficient solution using preventative and control technology to regulate CO2 emissions at their source over the long term. The main objective and purpose of this research work is to control and monitor the CO and CO2 emission using NodeMCU with the help of IoT module to communicate the above parameter using wireless and the automatic buffering system which help to dilute the harmful gas at instantly. Air quality sensor is fixed in both inlet and outlet of the tube to monitor the CO2 level. IoT device is fixed to display the inlet and outlet of the carbon dioxide level.

articleTitle: Unveiling Anomalies in Surveillance Videos Through Various Transfer Learning Models
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Video anomaly detection touches upon the process of automatically identifying abnormal events or behaviors in video streams. It plays a crucial role in various domains, including security, surveillance, and safety monitoring. Traditional methods of video analysis often rely on manual inspection, which often requires a significant amount of time and is susceptible to human error. The concept of video anomaly detection aims to overcome these limitations by leveraging advanced technologies such as computer vision and machine learning. This research study performs a relative analysis on the models of deep learning such as VGG16, Resnet50, VGG19, DenseNet121 to deal with video anomaly detection. This study uses subsets of various classes of UCF crime datasets. The UCF Crime Dataset contains 1903 video clips captured from real-world surveillance cameras. Results show Densenet-121 with an ROC-AUC score of 0.85 performs better when vis-á-vis the other models used in this study.

articleTitle: SENT2BAYES: A Hybrid Machine Learning Model Combining Word2vec and Multi-Nomial Naive Bayes Classifier for Movie Review Sentiment Analysis in Twitter
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Movie review sentiment analysis has gained significant attention due to the vast amount of user-generated content available on social media platforms like Twitter. Accurately analyzing sentiment from such data can provide valuable insights into public opinion and assist in decision-making processes. In the current work, a novel machine learning model, called Sent2Bayes, for movie review sentiment analysis on Twitter is proposed. The proposed model combines the power of Word2Vec embeddings and the Multinomial Naive Bayes classifier to enhance sentiment prediction accuracy. The Sent2Bayes model begins with the creation of Word2Vec embeddings, which capture semantic relationships between words and encode contextual information. These embeddings are then fed into the Multinomial Naive Bayes classifier, which leverages probabilistic modelling to predict sentiment labels for movie reviews. By combining the strength of Word2Vec's semantic understanding and Multi-nomial Naive Bayes' probabilistic approach, Sent2Bayes aims to improve the accuracy and robustness of sentiment analysis on Twitter data. To evaluate the performance of Sent2Bayes, this study conducts an extensive simulation experiments comparing it with existing algorithms commonly used for sentiment analysis. Further, this study employs suitable simulation metrics, including accuracy, precision, recall, and confusion matrix, to measure the model's predictive capabilities and generalization ability. The simulation results demonstrate that Sent2Bayes achieves superior sentiment analysis performance compared to SVM and RNN. The proposed model shows higher accuracy, precision, recall, and confusion matrix across various datasets and test scenarios. The improved performance of Sent2Bayes effectively captures contextual information through Word2Vec embeddings and the robust probabilistic modelling of Multinomial Naive Bayes.

articleTitle: Age Estimation from Facial Images Using the YOLO Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: A computer vision task called “age estimation based on facial images” seeks to estimate a person's age by examining their facial features. It has drawn a lot of interest because of its possible applications in numerous industries. In this research work, a novel approach based on YOLO Algorithm is proposed to solve age estimation. To implement age estimation using YOLO, the algorithm needs to be trained on a dataset that contains annotated images with corresponding age labels. During training, the YOLO network learns to detect facial features and extract relevant information related to age, such as wrinkles, skin texture, and facial expressions. Once trained, the YOLO algorithm can be used to estimate the age of individuals in new images. It analyzes the image and applies regression techniques to predict the age range of each detected face. The output can be a set of predefined age groups or a continuous numerical value representing the estimated age. The trained model is then tested against a validation dataset, and measures like mean absolute error and mean squared error are used to gauge how well it performed. The model can be used to determine the age of fresh facial photos after it has been validated. Experiments are conducted on the app a-real dataset and results are found to be better than current state of art techniques.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Transformer Ensemble Approach for Phishing Website Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: The internet has developed into a veritable informational gold mine in the era of the digital age, and URLs (Uniform Resource Locator) act as access points to enormous volumes of material. For a variety of applications, including web content classification, fraud detection, and information retrieval, it is essential to extract useful properties from URLs. The proposed approach investigates the potential for extracting useful information from URLs using transformer-based models. Transformers can be configured to decode the underlying patterns and semantics in URLs, which frequently display complicated structures and variations. Due to their exceptional abilities in natural language processing, they are used to effectively encode and represent the properties of the provided URLs. The approach uses pre-trained transformer models like BERT (Bidirectional Encoder Representation from Transformers), optimizing their feature extraction performance on unique URLs. Later, a stacking strategy is used that combines machine learning models to further improve accuracy. Stacking is a potent ensemble approach and makes use of the diverse strengths of various models to provide predictions that are more reliable and accurate. By providing a quick and accurate method to identify phishing websites, the proposed approach makes contribution to field of internet security and protects consumers from potential cyber risks.

articleTitle: Automated Identification and Prioritization of Self-Admitted Technical Debt Using NLP Word Embeddings
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Managing technical debt is critical for software quality and maintainability. Self-Admitted Technical Debt (SATD) is a type of debt explicitly reported by developers in various software artifacts. This study proposes an automated approach to identify and prioritize SATD using Natural Language Processing (NLP) word embeddings. Proposed objectives include designing feature extraction and selection methods for debt classification, creating a model for SATD identification in issue tracking systems, and establishing a priority model for debt classification and refactoring probability. In this study, bag-of-words model is integrated into NLP word embeddings to enhance accuracy. Through a comprehensive analysis, the study compares proposed approach with existing models, demonstrating superior performance. Furthermore, a literature review on AI-powered tools for technical debt management, highlighting their potential and limitations are discussed. This study addresses the gap in SATD identification from issue tracking systems and showcase proposed approach's effectiveness through experiments on open-source projects. Proposed work provides valuable insights and a practical framework for software development teams to mitigate technical debt efficiently and effectively.

articleTitle: A Novel Ensembling of CNN-A-LSTM for IoT Electric Vehicle Charging Stations Based on Intrusion Detection System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: The electric vehicle industry is expanding rapidly. This calls for a reliable setting capable of satisfying clients' needs. The Internet of Things (IoT) ecosystem is responsible for the explosion in EV charging station data. An electric vehicle charging station management system (EVCSMS) is the necessary technology for this. However, there is a growing concern that IoT infrastructure will be the target of a cyberattack. Intrusion detection systems (IDSs) play a crucial role in helping traditional IT networks spot harmful activities. Proposed research indicates that a classifier strategy based on machine learning is the most effective way to detect fraud in an IoT network. The suggested methodology makes use of an authentic IoT dataset collected from actual IoT traffic. There is a comparison of several different types of classification systems. Both binary and multiclass traffic models were successful. When the proposed method is implemented in the IoT-based IDS engine that supports EV charging stations, a significant number of cyberattacks that may otherwise disrupt normal life will be prevented. Preprocessing, feature selection, and model performance evaluation are all parts of the proposed method. The suggested model employs preprocessing via normalization, PCA for feature selection, and a CNN-A-LSTM for assessing model performance. When compared to the CNN and LSTM models, the proposed method performs admirably.

articleTitle: Influential Node-Based Random Walk Graph Embedding with Graph Neural Networks in Complex Graphs
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Centrality Metrics are widely used metrics for graph analysis, which involves describing the significant nodes in terms of connected nodes, mostly positioned in all geodesic paths and often connected to higher degree nodes. It is crucial to various applications, including Personalized Recommendation, Community Detection, and Network Split. Computing these metrics on scale-free graphs is a challenging factor about time complexity. To compute these social metrics, this research study considers a generalized form of all neural models called Graph Neural Network (GNN). A GNN is a class of deep neural models for graph processing. GNNs perceive two functions: aggregation and combination. Aggregator controls the internal structure through neighborhood aggregation by considering each node's embedding feature later, the combination function joins this with the node itself. The proposed work uses different embedding methods like Node2Vec, DeepWalk, Stuct2Vec, and Random walk with a restart to map graph structure into vector space for prediction. As random walks are a demanding task for these algorithms, in this work a proven computationally less approach is used. By training on well-known data, the proposed model produced random walks proportionally with the structural features. Experiments on random scale-free graphs prove that the proposed model attains accuracy without scarifying the computational speed.

articleTitle: Validation and Verification of Remaining Useful Life Prediction for Lithium-Ion Batteries based on AM-CNN Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: An empirical model decomposition algorithm, Elman neural networks, and long-term memory are employed to predict the remaining battery life. The method for deconstructing empirical models is given the data on battery capacity vs cycle number that has been acquired. After that, recurrent long short-term memory and Elman neural networks are used to make predictions for the high-frequency and low-frequency sub-layers, respectively. Data gathered at an unprecedented scale during battery testing has aided in model parameterization and performance evaluation. The first three steps of the proposed process are processing the data, choosing the features to use, and training the model. The proposed approach uses a Denoising Transformer (De-Transformer) network to clean up the raw data. The extended Kalman Particle Filter (EKPF) is a crucial sample density function that the proposed system employ in feature selection. AM-CNN is then used to train the models after the features have been chosen. The proposed method is superior to AM and CNN, two common substitutes.

articleTitle: Enhancing Network Security in SDNIoT Environments Through CNN-Based Attack Detection
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: The rapid proliferation of Internet of Things (IoT) devices connected to the internet has given rise to an increase in IoT-based attacks, thereby necessitating the development of effective intrusion detection systems. This research addresses the challenges posed by the evolving threat landscape in Software Defined Network (SDN)-assisted IoT (SDNIoT) environments. Traditional intrusion detection solutions encounter difficulties in coping with the coexistence of conventional and IoT protocols in a centralized network architecture. To mitigate this issue, a novel approach is proposed, utilizing Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) for accurate attack detection within SDNIoT networks. The approach involves employing CNN architectures, which possess the capability to learn complex hierarchical patterns, for intrusion detection. The performance of the CNN model is extensively evaluated on two distinct SDNIoT-focused datasets, encompassing both binary and multiclass classification scenarios. Furthermore, a detailed analysis of the architectural components of the model is introduced, offering insights into the visualization of learned features. The proposed CNN-based framework demonstrates impressive capabilities in identifying and categorizing network attacks in SDNIoT networks. Proposing a novel approach employing Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) for precise attack detection, the model is evaluated on two SDNIoT datasets. Results showcase the CNN's remarkable capabilities, achieving an accuracy of 99.75% and 99.80% on “NetworkFlow_X” and “NetAttack_Y” datasets, respectively. This research contributes to the field by harnessing advanced deep learning techniques to enhance network security, thereby addressing the challenges posed by IoT-based threats within the SDN framework.

articleTitle: Roaming the Coffee Plantations Using Grey Wolves Optimisation and the Restricted Boltzmann Machine to Predict Coffee Berry Disease
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Everyone's daily regimen includes a cup of coffee. However, even tiny changes in the coffee cherries cause significant differences in coffee quality, aroma, and flavor. Deep learning is used in the suggested method to forecast Coffee Berry Disease (Colletotrichum kahawai) and increase accuracy by utilizing the coffee cherry stages dataset with parameters incorporated in the Restricted Boltzmann Machine improvement model. The Grey Wolf meta-heuristic optimization algorithm was applied in this proposed study, an optimization technique that simulates Grey Wolf hunting behavior. As a result, the efficiency of the hypothesized model will improve. Furthermore, research shows that the proposed strategy is feasible and would be used to detect and outperform existing methodologies efficiently.

articleTitle: Analysis of Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia Detection Methods Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: This research work puts forward a comparative study of four prominent deep learning models - ResNet, InceptionNet, MobileNet and EfficientNet — for the classification and detection of Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia (ALL) from microscopic single blood cell images. Leukemia, a critical hematological malignancy, demands accurate and swift diagnosis to facilitate effective treatment. The advent of deep learning has revolutionized medical image analysis, enabling automated and efficient disease detection. In this work, we evaluate the performance of ResNet, InceptionNet, MobileNet, and EfficientNet, all of which have demonstrated exceptional capabilities in various computer vision tasks. The proposed study involves the construction of a dataset containing diverse blood cell images, which then undergoes preprocessing and augmentation to ensure model robustness and generalization. Subsequently, the four deep learning architectures are implemented, pretrained on large-scale image datasets, and fine-tuned on the leukemia dataset. Training, validation, and testing phases are conducted under controlled experimental conditions. The results reveal nuanced differences in the performance of ResNet, InceptionNet, MobileNet, and EfficientNet for leukemia detection and classification. The evaluation metrics provide insights into their strengths and limitations, helping guide selection based on specific application requirements. This study clarifies how various architectures impact model performance in the context of medical image analysis.

articleTitle: Lithium-Ion Health Prediction for Battery Systems Using Deep A-LSTM-CNN Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: This study developed a battery health indicator specific to lithium-ion cells and a moving-window technique for evaluating battery life. The curve of the partial charge voltage was used as a measure of cellular health. The battery's remaining life was estimated by fitting a linear aging model to the capacity data over a sliding window; forecast uncertainty was generated via Monte Carlo simulation.
