abstract: Applying the support vector machine-based Genomic Selection (GS) to improve the agricultural yield. The proposed work employs GS to address the pressing need for enhanced techniques for agricultural productivity. The proposed work examines GS's history, methodology, and results to demonstrate its superiority over conventional breeding techniques. The author indicates that by using in-depth case studies and comparative research, GS may enhance agricultural productivity and disease resistance. The findings extensively impact agriculture, including increased product safety and adopting sustainable practices. Ethical concerns regarding the use of GS in agriculture are also discussed, along with suggestions for further research in this area. The proposed work contributes to the burgeoning field of agricultural development by disclosing a novel technique for constructing stronger, more productive farms.

articleTitle: DocumentQA-Leveraging LayoutLMv3 for Next-Level Question Answering
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: With the increasing prevalence of digital documents in various domains, the demand for efficient and accurate question-answering (QA) systems has grown significantly. Traditional QA models primarily focus on text-based content, but the complex structure and visual elements present in documents pose unique challenges. This project explores the integration of LayoutLMv3, an advanced language and vision model, to elevate document question answering to the next level. The key role of LayoutLMv3 in document question answering (QA) lies in its ability to handle complex documents that contain not only textual information but also intricate visual elements like tables, images, and graphs. Traditional QA models typically focus on processing plain text and may struggle to comprehend the spatial arrangement and structure of documents. However, documents often contain vital information in their layout, which, if overlooked, can lead to inaccurate or incomplete answers. LayoutLMv3 overcomes this limitation by integrating both language and vision components into a single model. Through comprehensive tests on a variety of document datasets, this study shows the efficiency of DocumentQA. This study also analyzes the LayoutLMv3's interpretability and how it affects the way questions are answered. Through visualization techniques, various insights are gained on how the model analyses the document's layout, text, and interactions to generate accurate answers. The implications of this research extend beyond document QA, as LayoutLMv3's unique fusion of language and vision has broader applications in information retrieval, natural language processing, and document understanding tasks. The performance of LayoutLMv3 over LayoutLmv2 is also compared in this work showing efficient results.

articleTitle: Improved Machine Learning Scheme for Review Analysis Using Suggestion Based Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: For many people, especially potential customers, reading product reviews before purchasing the item becomes a habit. People frequently examine reviews of the current product from customers before making a purchase decision. There is a good possibility that customers will purchase the product if the review is primarily positive; but, if it is primarily negative, they usually choose another option. Although good customer feedback can result in substantial financial gains for organizations, it can also be considered when making decisions about how to create products and what services to offer consumers. Many of the daily activities have been influenced by the Internet's explosive rise. E-commerce is one of the sectors with the fastest development. E-commerce sites typically allow users to post feedback about products they have purchased.

articleTitle: Industry 4.0 Technologies for Smart Manufacturing: A Systematic Review of Machine Learning Methods for Predictive Maintenance
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: The automotive sector, which has a significant impact on economic and social growth, has been a driving force behind the development of Industry 4.0 and its associated technologies such as Smart Production, Smart Manufacturing, and the Internet of Things (IoT). One important area of focus within Industry 4.0 is the use of machine learning (ML) algorithms and predictive maintenance (PdM) methods to optimize manufacturing tool performance. With the advent of digital convergence and communication networks, it is now possible to collect vast amounts of process and performance data from different parts of manufacturing tools and use this data for diagnostic and automatic fault detection to reduce downtime and increase component utilization rates. This work provides a brief review of current developments in machine learning methods that are broadly useful for PdM in smart manufacturing within the context of Industry 4.0. The study categorizes research based on ML algorithms and focuses on the future prediction of temperature using time series and multivariate analysis techniques. By highlighting the state-of-the-art advances in ML and PdM for smart manufacturing, this paper aims to contribute to the ongoing effort to enhance manufacturing processes and improve competitiveness in the industry.

articleTitle: Application of RNN-ET-Based Digital Education Using Speech Interactions
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: In order to address this evolution, six tendencies are identified in this system. The tendencies are still there and will continue to have an impact on educational technology. The physicality of interactions and the learner's physical environment first emerged as genuine elements of digital education. The line separating the physical and the digital has vanished. Similar to how integrated learning scenarios have absorbed the conflict between individual and social views on cognition, AIED now places more emphasis on social interactions than it did in the beginning. Another development is the processing of learners' behavioral particles, which individually do not have a lot of semantic meaning but are predictive of knowledge states when processed by machine learning techniques on big data sets. Another trend has emerged as a result of the development of probabilistic models and the incorporation of crowdsourcing techniques: learning environment design is now less deterministic than it once was. The idea of a learning environment has developed from a somewhat tight box to an open ecosystem where various stakeholders can connect and where various components are dispersed across various platforms. Teachers now interact not only during the design phase (authoring), but also during the runtime phase (orchestration), which is significant to note among these stakeholders. Preprocessing, feature extraction, and model performance evaluation are all used in the suggested method. Normalization is used for preprocessing. It uses the Mel Filter Bank and DCT for feature extraction. It employs the RNN-ET Model for gauging the model's efficacy. The proposed method is evaluated in comparison to the RNN and the CNN models. When compared to more simplistic approaches, it excels.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Deep Learning based Water Potability Prediction
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: According to the United Nations, having access to clean water for consumption is a fundamental human right. General Assembly in 2010. The importance of safe drinking water cannot be overstated. Unsafe drinking water access is a significant public health concern, especially in poor nations. In many regions of the world, waterborne illnesses including cholera, typhoid fever, and dysentery are important causes of illness and death. These diseases are especially dangerous for children, who are more vulnerable to their effects. In addition, a lack of access to clean drinking water can result in other health issues like stunted growth and malnutrition. Access to safe drinking-water is also a key component of effective policy for health protection at all levels, whether it is at the national, regional, or local level. Policies aimed at improving access to safe drinking-water can include measures such as water quality testing, water treatment, and the provision of clean water sources. Investments in water supply and sanitation can have a positive economic impact, especially in areas with inadequate access to clean drinking water. The costs of implementing the treatments may be outweighed by the reductions in unfavorable health impacts and medical expenses that may result from these investments. In conclusion, having access to clean drinking water is crucial for encouraging wellness, reducing waterborne illnesses, and raising standard of living in general. The input to the DNN could be the various water quality parameters, such as pH, hardness, chloride content, and total dissolved solids, while the output would be a binary classification indicating whether the water is potable or not. The DNN would need to be trained on a large and diverse dataset of water samples to accurately classify new samples.

articleTitle: Harnessing Artificial Intelligence for Precise Pulmonary Disease Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Our study explores the possibility of deep learning techniques for pulmonary disease identification using the vast dataset for NIH chest X-rays, which is full of a wide range of anterior chest X-ray images annotated with various pulmonary disorders. Convolutional neural networks (CNNs), transfer learning paradigms, and ensemble models are just a few of the cutting-edge deep learning frameworks that we employ. Careful data preprocessing, image augmentation techniques and hyperparameter optimization strengthen these models. Our analysis carefully assesses model performance, relying on benchmark performance indicators such as accuracy, precision, recall, and the F1-score. The industry-leading deep learning model shows exceptional skill in the accurate diagnosis of various pathologies, frequently outperforming the diagnostic prowess of conventional machine learning approaches and, intriguingly, occasionally even outperforming the diagnostic skills of skilled radiologists. The key finding of this research study, which signals developments in the field of medical image analysis, is that deep learning plays a crucial role in automating the identification of pulmonary disorders. It highlights the need for additional research projects in this area, which could change how pulmonary diseases are diagnosed and treated in the future.

articleTitle: Traffic Sign Recognition using Convolutional Neural Networks YOLOv3 Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Nowadays, traffic sign recognition is disrupted through various external factors such as chromatic aberration, geographical separation, and brightness of lights. This eventually poses possible safety hazards during navigation in real life. To overcome this issue, a deeplearning based method is proposed in this research using YOLOv3 with DenseNet as the backbone design. This approach uses attention mechanism to accelerate the feature extraction process by minimizing the overhead due to high computations to optimize the latency problem. Secondly, it incorporates location-specific hierarchical network to increase the traffic sign detection performance in challenging circumstances such as magnitude and illumination variations while maintaining adaptability and flexibility. In addition to this Cross Stage Partial Network is fused with DenseNet to enhance the recognition accuracy and effectiveness of the proposed system. The experimental findings on the Chinese Traffic sign dataset, CCTSDB dataset, showed that the YOLOv3-DenseNet model exhibited significant detection efficiency of 97.6% than the other deep learning models considered for performance comparison. It is observed that the proposed model is capable enough to detect the traffic signs in complicated scenarios as well as in places where the traffic signs are placed in smaller dimensions.

articleTitle: Cybersecurity in Brain Computer Interface-Assisted Hemiplegia Rehabilitation: A Blockchain-Centric Perspective
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Brain-computer interface (BCI) systems have emerged as a promising technology for hemiplegia rehabilitation. However, ensuring the security and privacy of sensitive patient data and protecting against potential cyber threats in these systems is of utmost importance. Insufficient security in data storage exposes patient information to various risks, including unauthorized access, tampering, and data breaches. Inaccurate or compromised patient data may lead to incorrect treatment plans, ineffective rehabilitation techniques, and compromised patient safety. Furthermore, the lack of data integrity hinders accurate analysis and impedes advancements in hemiplegia rehabilitation research. Additionally, neglecting software patching security introduces vulnerabilities in Brain-Computer Interface (BCI) systems. This creates a breeding ground for cyber-attacks, potentially resulting in system malfunctions, manipulation of treatment parameters, or unauthorized control over the BCI system. These consequences can hinder patient progress, compromise the efficacy of rehabilitation protocols, and erode patient trust in the healthcare system. This research study presents a novel approach utilizing blockchain technology and Solidity smart contracts to address these challenges. The “EEGDataStorage” smart contract serves as a secure data storage solution, allowing EEG data to be stored on the blockchain while maintaining patient privacy and data integrity. Simultaneously, the contract interfaces with the “BCI Software Verification Interface”, enabling seamless interaction between data storage and software patch verification. In conclusion, blockchain technology presents a powerful solution for enhancing cybersecurity in BCI-based hemiplegia treatment.

articleTitle: Identification of Dental Implants with the Development of an Artificial Intelligence Model using Radiograph
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Recent years have seen rapid development and emergence of artificial intelligence (AI) study in dental and maxillofacial radiology. Dental radiography, which is frequently employed in clinical settings, offers a great source for AI advancement and has drawn the increasing research attention to enable its implementation for various uses. Diagnosing dental caries, periapical pathologies, and periodontal bone loss; categorizing cysts and tumors; cephalometric evaluation; osteoporosis screening; tooth recognition and forensic odontology; identification of dental implant systems; and image quality advancement were the categories used to group the application of AI. The present state of each application's AI approach was then reviewed. The majority of the studies that were examined showed that AI applications for dental radiography have much promise. However, due to several obstacles and constraints, more work must be done before they can be used in clinical practice.

articleTitle: Energy-Efficiency in Software-Defined Networking: Rule Placement Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Energy efficiency has lately evolved into a key objective of network research because of the increase in energy usage as well as CO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>emissions resulting from large-scale networks. It is possible to view the newly developed software-defined network (SDN) architecture as an appealing answer to this issue. These networks' ability to separate the control and data planes makes it simple to develop energy-sensitive routing models. In order to optimize the number of connections expected to meet a given traffic demand; this study uses an energy-aware rule insertion strategy to solve the issue of optimizing energy usage in SDN.

articleTitle: Implementing a Unique Identification System for Improved Traceability and Prevention of Counterfeit Drugs in the Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Block chain technology provides a secure and impenetrable platform for locating and tracking counterfeit medications within the supply chain of the pharmaceutical industry. This research proposes a novel Block chain-Enabled Unique Identification System (BEUIS) designed to revolutionize traceability and combat counterfeit drugs. BEUIS leverages block chain technology to create an immutable and transparent ledger, ensuring the authenticity of pharmaceutical products at every stage of the supply chain. Through the integration of smart contracts, it automates verification processes, significantly enhancing efficiency and reliability. The decentralized nature of block chain minimizes the risk of data manipulation and establishes a trustworthy environment for all stakeholders. BEUIS also promotes interconnectivity, allowing seamless integration with existing systems, thus offering a scalable and sustainable approach to addressing the global counterfeit drug epidemic. This research presents a comprehensive framework, emphasizing the implementation of BEUIS as a pivotal solution to safeguard public health and restore trust in the pharmaceutical sector. Its transparency and immutability make it a promising solution for improving public health. By utilizing block chain technology, the system offers an extremely secure and unalterable platform for the system provides a highly secure and tamper-proof platform for detecting and tracking counterfeit drugs. Its transparency and immutability make it a promising solution for improving public health outcomes.

articleTitle: Improvisation of Food Delivery Business by Leveraging Ensemble Learning with Various Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Food delivery has continuously been one of the most profitable and rapidly developing industries. As technology advances, the food delivery industry must develop new and creative services to give clients with better and timely services. The goal of this study is to investigate the application of ensemble machine learning (ML) methodologies in digital marketing for the food delivery industry. Artificial intelligence (AI) algorithms are used to evaluate customer data in order to uncover preferences and anticipate behavior, enabling AI-driven suggestions. The results show that the decision tree and nearest neighbor algorithms obtain flawless predictions, while the Naive Bayes algorithm gets a high overall accuracy of 97.175%. To improve customer satisfaction even further, study suggest a majority vote strategy that combines various models by mixing randomized data with real-world customer experiences, significantly lowering consumer aggravation. Surprisingly, the combination of three ML algorithms boosts digital marketing approaches for food delivery companies, resulting in lower resource expenditure while producing exceptional outcomes. This work adds to the body of knowledge by proving the efficacy of AI-driven ensemble learning in optimizing marketing tactics for the food delivery business. Thus strategy enables organizations to deliver better and more timely services by identifying client preferences and behavior, therefore cementing their position in this competitive market.

articleTitle: Develoment of an Accident Detection System Using IoT and Blynk Application
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: An accident is an unpredicted and unintentional event. With the number of drivers on the roads and the number of accidents happening growing, this system is designed to make driving safer. Not getting treatment in time is the main cause of half of all deaths in road crashes. It is observed that the existing system had been suggested as a very effective way to prevent accident dangers employing technologies like V2V communication, smart sensing, mobile edge computing, etc. But a lot of systems emphasize two-wheelers. Most systems make use of the Raspberry Pi as a microcontroller, which is then connected to various sensors. The proposed system is all about detecting accidents quickly and sending info to those who can help. If the driver is in an accident and the structure of the car gets distorted, the flex and mems sensor on the outer surface of the car will sense it and pass that info to an ESP32 module. The ESP32 microcontroller, which uses little power and has Bluetooth and Wi-Fi built in, is used for the research. Lower power consumption, a smaller size, and a lower price are benefits of an ESP32 over a Raspberry Pi. If the flex and mems frequency level is higher than programmed, the ESP32 board will get GPS data from a GPS module and send a notification and communicate the necessary information with driver's registered emergency contacts.

articleTitle: Medical Image Analysis of Multiple Myeloma Diagnosis Using CNN and KNN Based Approach
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Leukocytes, which are produced in the bone marrow, account for about 1% of all blood cells. When the production of these neutrophils becomes unchecked, cancer of the blood occurs. In order to better classify Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia (ALL) and Multiple Myeloma (MM), two of the three types of cancer studied, the proposed study makes use of the SN-AM dataset. Acute lymphoblastic leukemia (ALL) is a cancer characterized by an excess generation of lymphocytes in the bone marrow. However, malignant cells from multiple myeloma (MM) do not enter the bloodstream and instead remain in the bone marrow. Healthy stem cells are crowd out, which prevents the body from producing enough new blood cells. In the past, this would necessitate the dedicated time and energy of an expert. The proposed approach makes use of preprocessing, segmentation, feature extraction, and evaluating model performance. Median filters are utilized in the preparation of data because the capturing and transmitting of medical images is often hindered by noise. Cell Segmentation, as well as Nucleus and Cytoplasm Segmentation, are two common techniques used in segmentation. Gaussian pyramids is used for feature extraction. The CNN-KNN Model is used to evaluate the performance of the model. The KNN and CNN models are used as benchmarks against which the suggested method is assessed. It far surpasses simpler methods in comparison.

articleTitle: A Novel Deep Learning Assisted Lung Nodule Identification Mechanism with Intelligent Image Processing Principles
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Lung cancer has the greatest fatality rate of all cancers. Due to its efficacy, chest CT has become standard practice for lung cancer screening and diagnosis. Radiologists have a significant challenge when trying to detect nodules in 3D volume imaging due to the tiny size of their shadows. This research study has created a novel Computer-Aided Design (CAD) system that can automatically identify tumors in the lungs in CT scans to help with this problem. When it comes to cancers that can be fatal even if treated late, lung cancer is by far the most frequent. At now, CT can be utilized to aid in the early detection of lung cancer. The identification of lung cancer frequently relies on the expertise of medical professionals, who may overlook some patients and so exacerbate the situation. In several fields of medical imaging diagnostics, deep learning has shown to be an effective and widely used technique. This research work proposes an Intelligent Learning based Nodule Detection (ILND), a revolutionary deep learning-based approach to detecting lung cancer. This research study adapts those networks for use in classifying CT images of both malignant and benign lung nodules. The CT imaging dataset was used to assess the performance of the networks. The results of the experiments demonstrate that the suggested Intelligent Learning based Nodule Detection model outperformed the other network models, with an accuracy of 95.67%, a sensitivity of 93.65% and a specificity of 94.82%.

articleTitle: Audio-Video Based Fusion Mechanism Using Deep Learning for Categorical Emotion Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Multimodal emotion recognition is an advanced version of an artificial emotional intelligence system. Various solutions have been proposed to enhance the performance and emotion recognition rate. Multimodal is also one of the recent advanced research areas to classify and recognize emotions in realtime, consisting of physiological signals, facial expressions, audio-visual, audio-text, and video-text fusion. The proposed work uses advanced deep learning models to recognize the seven categorical emotions from the audio and video modality. Different modalities' feature extraction techniques and landmarks, such as Audio and Video, play a vital role in recognizing emotions. It also illustrates the Audio-video-based feature fusion mechanism. It computes the complementary relationship between the different modalities and shows the improved performance using the RESNET20 model for audio modality and the 3DCNN model for video modality on the RAVDESS dataset. Opensmile toolkit is used to extract the compelling features from the audio model and fuse them with extracted features of video modality. Feature fusion mechanism fuses the extracted features of audio and video data to classify and enhance the accuracy of recognized categorical emotions. It also briefly discusses the various audio-video features fusion approaches, computational accuracy and robustness of the proposed model. It shows a result of 71.3% and 69.7%. Accuracy on validation and test datasets outperforms the state-of-the-art models in the multimodal emotion recognition domain with a fusion mechanism.

articleTitle: Brain Tumour Ordering Using Visual Geometry Group Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: A person's life may be significantly impacted negatively by brain tumours as they can impair cognitive function, causing memory loss, trouble concentrating, and personality or behaviour changes. By examining medical imaging data such as magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) scans, classification algorithms can be trained to learn and identify outlines and structures in the pictures that are associated with the existence or nonappearance of a brain tumor and to diagnose it. The general classification challenges in brain tumor classification include tumor heterogeneity, imaging technique limitations, limited sample size, lack of standardization, and incomplete understanding of the underlying biology. In the past, researchers have used various techniques such as traditional machine learning algorithms, deep learning models, and ensemble methods to classify brain tumors. These limitations can often lead to erroneous accuracy at times even after thorough training on a model which may hamper the desired output required for a medical diagnosis. This paper focuses on applying preprocessing methods to the MRI scans of brain tumor in order to establish uniformity among the inputs. Our main objective is to apply a texture descriptor classification which. Thus, our novel approach is focused on an improved algorithm which will prove to be robust to monotonic gray-scale changes caused. The proposed strategy intends to improve the inputs, which will be integrated into a classification algorithm with the efforts to obtain precise results and improved accuracy. The superiority and diversity of the preparation data, as well as the particular parameters and hyperparameters used to train the model, are all factors that affect how well these models function.

articleTitle: Hardware Implementation of Block Ciphers – A Case Study on Encrypted Image Transfer Over Universal Asynchronous Receiver Transmitter
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Communication protocols such as Universal Asynchronous Receiver/Transmitter (UART), Serial Peripheral Interface (SPI), Inter-Integrated Circuits (I2C), and Computer Area Networks (CAN) exist to facilitate communication among devices. This work studies a comparison of the additional overhead of offering Advanced Encryption Standard (AES)-128 and PRESENT-64 algorithms with reconfigurable UART on the transmitter and receiver side to offer data encryption. Advanced Encryption Standard (AES) in the basic loop architecture and PRESENT in the fully unrolled architecture for their implementation in the proposed study of secured data transfer over the UART channel. AES-128 consumes almost three times more clock cycles to encrypt and decrypt than PRESENT-64. Considering that AES-128 takes only double the input size of PRESENT-64 and requires thrice the number of clock cycles, AES-128 is more time-consuming. Xilinx Field Programmable Gate Array (FPGA) implementation results suggest that PRESENT-64 consumes slightly more onboard resources than AES-128 since the proposed work employs an unrolled PRESENT architecture. The complete architecture is specified using Verilog HDL and implemented in Xilinx families, namely Artix7, Spartan6, Virtex6, and Virtex7 series of FPGAs.

articleTitle: Optimal Load Flow Analysis for Distributed Generation in Radial Distribution Systems Using Modified Newton Raphson Method
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: The economic status of the country depends upon the power consumption, if the power consumption is more and then there is a chance of over loading in the transmission lines, which may result in more losses. According to one hypothesis. the voltage profile of a radial distribution system with distributed generation (DG) can be enhanced by adding more effective control mechanisms for both actual and reactive power. Because it imnroves system stability and successtully reduce power dissipation in radial distribution networks, distributed production systems outperform traditional approaches for limiting power loss. In order to undertake a comprehensive examination of load flow, the current study used a real-time distribution system in India comprised of 25 buses. The location of distribution generation also identified with trial and error method. The Wind Turbine Generator System (WTGS) is located in different buses to improve the voltage profile. The detailed analysis is carried out with the E-TAP system.

articleTitle: Empowering Digital Twin Development: A Profound Exploration with Altair Tools
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Digital Twin (DT) Technology is fast becoming an integral part of various industries. Companies looking to transform their businesses are embracing it at a faster pace since this innovative tool can quickly detect and solve physical issues, design and build better products, enhance operational efficiency and infuse greater profits. The driving force behind this technology is its ability to create or replicate real-time digital representation of physical assets by deploying smart sensors, which collect data resulting in better interpretation, judgement, forecast and improved product performance. This paper deals with developing Digital Twin for a DC motor that actuates serial arm manipulators, incorporating Altair tools such as Altair Inspire, Compose, Activate, Panopticon and HyperWorks. This project focused on creating a Digital Twin based on a DC motor's thermal model, that can accurately predict its temperature, the amount of current it holds, and its expected behavioural patterns in a given situation. In order to achieve real-time object detection, our research involved deploying YOLO V5s model on a Raspberry Pi, specifically targeting perfume, medicine, and juice bottles in domestic settings. The key result of this research is the Reduced Order Model Artificial Intelligence (ROMAI) model, which accurately predicts the amount of current in a base motor, and its temperature, using data thrown up by current and temperature sensors. Thus, it can be safely concluded that the ROMAI Model serves as a critical component in ensuring Digital Twin's operational reliability, equipping it better to respond effectively to the DC motor's changing conditions.

articleTitle: Heart Beat Sound Signals Classification Using Spectral Roll Off
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: cardiovascular diseases, abnormalities or dysfunctions related to heart or blood vessels may occur due to a number of reasons i.e., anxiety, stress, higher blood pressure, cholesterol, diabetes, alcohol consumption, and smoking. Some cardiovascular diseases also involve the presence of irregular heartbeats as either symptoms or indicators of other underlying conditions. The proposed research work aims to identify and classify a patient's heartbeat as irregular or regular based on the sample data inputs. However, the sample data consists of unbalanced classes i.e., sample size of irregular heartbeats. This issue has been addressed through SMOTE up-sampling technique. Another problem exists while trying to achieve the end goal of identifying a patient's heartbeats as regular or irregular, that is, the presence of a high number of features i.e., around one lakh ten thousand. Due to this, the classification model becomes complex and analyzing data becomes inefficient and complex. This also creates the problem of the curse of dimensionality which, here, is addressed through SPECTRAL ROLL OFF of featured extraction. Post this, features will be further reduced to a smaller number using MEAN SPECTRAL ROLL OFF of feature extraction. Once the features have been reduced, analysis is performed. Through this analysis, logistic regression predicts the incoming patient's heartbeats as regular or irregular. Through the performance matrices, the result's accuracy is declared.

articleTitle: Advanced Power Management for Electric Vehicle Charging Station
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: As the number of autos on the road continues to rise at an alarming rate, the day will come when automobiles will outnumber humans. As a result of such a tragedy, already scarce resources like fossil fuels would be depleted. As the number of hybrid and electric vehicles on the road grows, it is critical to extend the charging station network. Superchargers and mega chargers allow high-capacity vehicles to quickly recharge their batteries. This initiative was the first of its kind due to the manner in which it was put together. This research looks at the several types of energy that can be used to charge electric vehicles (EVs), with a focus on solar energy and traditional utility electricity. To assist cars and pedestrians in locating available parking places, a parking sensor system with LCD displays has been installed. Invoicing will begin as soon as a vehicle parks in a zone that requires a pass. This is true whether or not the driver possesses the necessary license. After the charging procedure has been successfully completed, the transaction can be completed by transmitting the agreed-upon sum using the RFID card.

articleTitle: Built in Self Test on Random Test Pattern Generation for Test Compression
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Since it is utilized to test every operating function inside the IC circuit, BIST is regarded as a benefit in all ICs. Since it uses more power and a separate circuit, it is not necessary to test the IC's operations in this way. Utilizing the BIST lowers the extra circuit's power usage. Despite the fact that it minimizes the power consumption of extra circuits, it still uses a lot of electricity. There are several ways to solve the issue of power utilzation, but there is no way to lower it. Although PRPG is an important method used for power reduction techniques which is used in BIST since it provides pseudo-random patterns for testing, it also consumes a significant amount of power because of pattern switching and repetition. BIST is created using RTPG to get around the problems that toggling and repetition now provide. The RTPG uses MISR to cut down on duplication. MISR steers clear of pattern repetition. The pattern is decreased to lower the power use. So, the power usage is decreased while implementing our suggested solution.

articleTitle: A Modified Low-Offset High Speed Comparator Circuit for Flash Converter Architecture
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Advances in the implementation of hand held devices would not be possible without the accurate design of an analog to digital converter architecture. An essential component in this converter architecture is the CMOS comparator. The previous comparators operate with high delay, due to which the speed reduces as well as the circuits suffer from larger offset voltages. In this work, a modified CMOS comparator architecture is developed to study its non-linear and time varying characteristics. The propagation delay, power dissipation, power delay product and offset voltage analysis are carried out in this work and compared with the conventional comparator. The proposed comparator architecture is designed and simulated in Cadence Virtuoso tools in 180nm CMOS process technology at a power supply voltage <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathrm{V}_{\text{DD}}=1.8\mathrm{V}$</tex>. Com pared to the earlier comparator architectures, the offset voltage reduced by 9%, power delay product deceased by 12% and the total delay reduced by 8%. Based on the obtained simulation results, the proposed modified comparator circuit can be used in the comparator bank segment of a Flash analog to digital converter architecture.

articleTitle: Data-Driven Approaches for Oropharyngeal Cancer Screening with Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Oropharyngeal cancer is a significant global health issue requiring early and accurate screening. The proposed work has a data-driven, machine-learning-based strategy for oropharyngeal cancer screening. Using the Random Forest method, constructed a model for making predictions from a massive dataset. According to the study's findings, this model has tremendous potential for identifying cases of suspected oropharyngeal cancer. The model's emphasis on critical predictive characteristics makes it particularly useful for identifying possible troublemakers. This machine learning-based screening method has the potential to significantly increase the detection of oropharyngeal cancer, leading to more effective treatments and better patient outcomes. The findings from the proposed work highlight the significance of data-driven medical screening efforts for the early detection of cancer and the consequent prevention of human suffering.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of TED Model in Plastic Waste Management
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Plastic waste Management is one of the most important sections in every industry and individual levels. The importance of the theme provokes the researchers to focus on correlation of intelligent techniques to study the challenges involved in proper implementation of the same. In this regard the work exposes the origin and technical challenges and solutions involved in the Plastic waste management. One of the major obstacles is cost benefit analysis at individual phase. The work explains the role of intelligent technology in elaborating the inherent challenges and solutions and explains TED (Techno economical demand) Model of Plastic Waste Management. In this work, the cost benefit analysis performed by introducing novel structure of plastic waste management and applied the strategy of Big Bang big crunch & Ray optimisation algorithm method of optimisation to study the cost benefit analysis.

articleTitle: CogniPoseAI: A Futuristic AI-Enhanced Personal Trainer
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: In the last several years, human posture estimation is one of the key areas of research in the field of computer Vision. This research employs pose estimation using deep learning and machine learning approaches to analyze performance and provide real-time feedback repetitions.The application of machine learning in the fitness industry could potentially aid judges in accurately monitoring the number of repetitions executed during weightlifting or CrossFit competitions. The software application that recognizes a person's exercise posture, counts repetitions and provides detailed recommendations to improve their form. This process uses Mediapipe to recognize human poses and analyze datasets and real-time video to make decisions and Count repetitions of a specific exercise.

articleTitle: Efficient Brain-Computer Interface for Attention Detection in Health Care Industry
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: A cognitive component of brain activity is attention. The effectiveness of other activities, including the learning process and crucial ones, are greatly impacted. Here, several methods are employed to categorize human attention according to ERP. The Electroencephalography (EEG) signal known as the Event-Related Potential (ERP) P300 is an evoked potential that has been linked to a number of cognitive functions, including response choice and attention. This study utilize the MOABB ERP Dataset bi2013a in this case. This was derived from a study conducted at GIPSA-lab in 2013 by the University of Grenoble Alpes, the CNRS, and Grenoble-INP. With the use of statistical Time domain analysis techniques like means and standard deviation of the filtered EEG data, the P300 ERP may be recovered from the raw EEG signal. Distinct P300 classifiers were utilized in this study, four of which were based on Riemannian geometry: CSP LDA, ERPCov TS LR, ERPCov MDM, as well as LR, LDA, and SVM classifiers. By analysing the data, it is concluded that LR performs better than the competition and generates positive test results on categorising the p300 ERP, which directly indicates the attention of the individual individuals.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Low Power Model for Induction Coil
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: The existing household electric induction cooker appears ineffective due to single induction coil usage. This study involves the preliminary design of an electronic control circuit with two induction coils in the same unit of an induction cooker to achieve low power consumption and maximum heat generation. The rectifier unit in the induction cooker converts Alternating Current input power to direct current acts as input for the oscillator circuit. The oscillator converts the direct current electricity into high-frequency alternating current to power the two induction coils connected in series. This method improves the proper usage of two induction coils to save the consumption power more effectively than the existing method of single induction coil usage in cooking.

articleTitle: Automatic Pathway Diverter for Conveyor in Packing Section of Cement Factory
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Packed cement bags from the rotary electronic packer lead to the two branches of conveyor belts to load the cement bags on the truck with various vehicle capacities or customer demands. A diverter in the midway of the conveyor path directs the cement bag to the appropriate conveyor branch for filling the trucks in the loading area. The operator needs information from the external person to track the truck space, customer demand or count. Automation to this unit at the preliminary prototype level for diverting the cement bags from the common conveyor path to branches of the conveyor belt attempted to load the exact count of cement bags according to the appropriate truck capacity using an infrared sensor placed in the branches of the conveyor belt loading the truck.

articleTitle: Automatic Music Player Based on the Facial Expression
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: A user's emotion or mood can be detected by their facial expression. These expressions can be exported from a live stream through the system camera. Many explorations are underway in the fields of computer vision and machine learning (ML), where machines are trained to recognize the rich variety of feelings or deadly emotions. Knowledge of machines offers colorful ways to detect deadly feelings. A similar approach is to use CNN models with Keras. Mortal feelings are closely related to music. In our proposed system, an emotion-based music player is created that performs real- time emotion detection and plays songs from YouTube web based on the detected emotion. One of the main benefits of integrating emotion detection is customer satisfaction.

articleTitle: Agent-Based Attribution Selection for Communicable Disease Surveillance Model Using Analytic Hierarchy Process
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: The Communicable diseases are becoming major issues in India due to economic, social and infrastructures. In particular, the statistics of 58% death in India between age group from 5 to 14 years are due to Communicable diseases. In Recently years almost all countries lost a considerable amount of their people due to the pandemic of COVID'19. A report of World Health Organization stated that, from 15th Feb'20 to 13th June'20 about 30,503,166 people were affected and 4,20,043(1% of total population) lost their lives. There are huge losses with respect economically and socially due to the recent communicable disease so called Covid'19, not just because it was new, but also because of failure to predict and manage the pandemic. This study proposes a design of an agent-based model for communicable diseases to effectively select primary symptoms of communicable diseases with its variants, since attributes selection is the core part of any analytics system. The consideration of all attributes can lead to waste of time, storage, and cost, as well as selection of inappropriate and inadequate attributes also leads to the results as inaccuracy. So, the proposed an agent -based model to select primary attributes of communicable diseases with any variants using Analytic Hierarchy Process, which will be used on collected data for prediction analysis instead of all attributes in the data set.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Algorithms for Early Alzheimer's Diagnosis: From Data to Prognosis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Alzheimer's disease (AD) is a neurological condition that worsens over time and affects millions of older people worldwide. An early diagnosis and correct classification of AD are essential for improving patient condition, enabling prompt intervention, and allocating healthcare resources. Healthcare professionals can use the system's predictions and classifications to make judgements about treatment regimens, patient counselling, and resource allocation. Additionally, by offering insightful information on the course of disease, potential therapeutic targets, and creation of fresh remedies, the system advances research into AD. To build reliable models for the precise diagnosis and classification of the disease, deep learning techniques were used to offer a cutting-edge AD prediction and classification system. To train and optimize deep neural networks, the system uses an AD dataset that consists of Magnetic resonance imaging(MRI) images. The dataset consists of 4 classes, Mild Demented, Moderate Demented, Non-Demented and Very Mild Demented. The proposed approach seeks to improve the precision, sensitivity, and specificity of AD prediction and classification by utilizing the power of deep learning. To identify complex patterns and correlations in the data, different deep learning architectures such as ResNet, MobileNet, and Xception are considered. ResNet exhibits the highest predictive accuracy among the three models, achieving an impressive 93%, followed closely by MobileNet at 91%, while Xception achieves an accuracy of 88%. The system's predictive models and classification algorithms can distinguish between various disease phases of the disease.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Oil Tank Cleaning System Using IoT
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Industries manufacture fuel and stored it for future needs, but it leads to produces sludge. In order to clean that sludge, Industries use manpower and other harmful chemicals. By using chemicals, workers are exposed to hazardous chemicals, which cause health issues. Workers used for these types of jobs must wear safety clothes and a separate safety mask for breathing. Workers can't work for more than an hour because it will be congested and cause breathing problems. It takes nearly a week to clean one tank. It consumes more time. The proposed solution is to make an IoT-based device to clean those tanks in a short period of time. The device can be easily controlled through mobile or some other system. It will be cost-efficient. The high amount of pressurized water will be pumped out and drained. If the presence of solid particles is more the additives are used and scrubbed through the scrubber and washed out of the tank. In comparison to the present method, it is a simple way, to reduce the pollution level, less time consumption, and ensure worker safety. The fundamental benefit of this technology is that it saves time, provides security for laborers, is cost-effective, and delivers efficient cleaning.

articleTitle: Improvement of the Effective Bandwidth of Multistage Amplifier by Cascading the Individual Two Stage Feedback Amplifiers
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: For the enhancement of amplitude of the signals, amplifiers are the circuits commonly used, where transistors either BJT or FET or op-amps are commonly used as the active elements of the same. Even though single stage amplifier provides certain amount of gain, it may not be enough for some applications. In this scenario, employment of multi-stage amplifiers is one of the effective solutions. Multistage cascaded amplifiers are very much important in the electronic industry because of the higher gain provided by them. One of challenges associated with the existing multistage cascaded amplifier is that they will reduce the effective bandwidth in a drastic manner which should be avoided. Related research works show good improvement in gain, but they are facing the drawback of higher reduction in the bandwidth. In this research study, the individual 2-stage cascaded amplifiers with series shunt feedback in first stage are cascaded to generate the higher stage multistage cascaded amplifier (MCA) with enhanced bandwidth than the conventional MCA. The proposed design is an optimized solution that improves the bandwidth of the n-stage MCA nearly by a factor less than n with reduction of gain by some amount.

articleTitle: Transfer Learning for Rice Plant Leaves Classification
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: This study suggests a transfer learning-based methodology for categorizing rice leaf diseases. The approach makes use of a pre-trained model that was developed using a sizable picture dataset. The model can take characteristics out of pictures, which are then used to categories the pictures. A collection of pictures of rice leaves was used to train the model. 100 epochs are used to train the model. The predictions for the rice leaf disease are quite encouraging. The total accuracy is fairly good at 0.94. At 0.95, the macro average F1 score is likewise exceptionally high. This indicates that the model can accurately forecast the occurrence of all three illnesses. With flawless accuracy, recall, and F1-score, the model excels in predicting leaf smut. This is hardly shocking considering how distinct and simple it is to recognize leaf smut.

articleTitle: Identification and Classification of Leukemia Using Machine Learning Approaches
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Leukemia is a form of cancer that affects people of any age but is particularly frequently seen in kids aged between the ages of five and eight. One of two methods is typically used for diagnosing it. The first approach is the traditional method of manually examining samples of blood extracted from microscope pictures; however, this method has a drawback in that when leukemia cells and healthy ones are the same, the diagnosis procedure gets more complicated. The second method employs image categorization algorithms. Algorithms employed in data mining techniques are extremely important in the field of health care, particularly in the event of discovering previously unknown patterns or models in databases. The classification is becoming more popular in Machine Learning and Deep Learning methods. The purpose of this research is to examine ML and DL approaches for recognizing and forecasting leukemia. The present research attempts to uncover several ML and DL-based classification methods that exploit the greatest prediction accuracy for leukemia cancer cells in added to the existing methods.

articleTitle: Cyber Attack Detection System in University Private Cloud Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: As cloud computing adoption in colleges continues to rise, the security of private cloud systems has become a paramount concern. Data breaches resulting from cyber attacks can inflict severe damage to a university's revenue and reputation. This research proposes a novel machine learning-based cyber threat detection system tailored to the university's private cloud environment. The system's main objective is to continuously monitor the cloud infrastructure and employ advanced machine learning algorithms to analyze network traffic, identify and prevent unusual activities that may indicate potential cyber-attacks. Here, the challenges posed on two sides of known possible threats and attack worldwide come across, and administrative defaults leads to security hole. By leveraging the power of machine learning, this innovative system aims to enhance the university's cyber defence capabilities. It considers the dynamic and evolving nature of cyber threats, enabling real-time detection and proactive measures against malicious activities. The integration of cutting-edge machine learning models and feature extraction techniques empowers the system to identify patterns of anomalous behaviour, even in the face of sophisticated attacks. Key components of the proposed system include network traffic analysis, anomaly detection and threat intelligence integration. Through the analysis of network packets and access logs, the system can effectively detect signs of unauthorized access, data exhilaration, and other cyber threats. Additionally, threat intelligence feeds provide the system with up-to-date information on emerging threats, enabling quick responses to potential risks. Moreover, the system's implementation adheres to privacy and data protection regulations, ensuring secure handling of sensitive information within the private cloud environment. Regular updates and adaptive learning capabilities enable the system to evolve with changing cyber threats, ensuring continued robustness in the face of new challenges. In conclusion, the proposed machine learning-based cyber attack detection system presents a powerful solution to safeguard the university's private cloud infrastructure. By promptly detecting and mitigating potential cyber threats, the system acts as a proactive defence mechanism, safeguarding valuable data and preserving the university's reputation in the ever-evolving landscape of cyber security.

articleTitle: An Optimal Approach for Prediction of Covid-19 Based on Machine Learning and Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Globally, the number of COVID-19 infections has reached almost 260 million, with an estimated roughly 4.2 million deaths. This happened when the number of coronavirus infections and fatalities increased. The extreme occurrence of COVID-19, a deficiency of efficient resources in many organizations to deal with the epidemic, and a delay in diagnosis are all possible explanations for this rise in numbers. Therefore, assessing the major pitfall of COVID-19 individuals is crucial because doing so may have numerous positive outcomes. This research shows that predictions concerning COVID-19 can be accurately made using deep learning techniques.

articleTitle: LPG Gas Level Monitoring and Leakage Detection System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG) plays a significant role in our daily lives. However, handling it with the utmost care is crucial due to its high ignitability, which can lead to fire outbreaks and explosions. The accurate calculation of gas leakage and the precise capacity of LPG cylinders remains challenging. To address these concerns, a robust gas leakage detection and monitoring system becomes imperative. The primary objective of this research design is to provide real-time information regarding the LPG gas level within the cylinder and promptly identify any instances of gas leakage. In the event of a gas leak, an alert mechanism, such as a buzzer, will notify the user. The design incorporates gas detectors and cargo cells that enable gas level identification and leak detection. Additionally, a television display visualizes the quantity of gas present, accompanied by alert messages. By activating the buzzer and indicator upon gas leakage detection, immediate attention is drawn to prevent potential hazards. This research design not only offers insights into the LPG gas level during refilling. It also functions as a powerful tool to mitigate gas leakage incidents and promote overall safety. Consequently, it proves instrumental in advancing LPG cylinder technology.

articleTitle: Integration of a Full Wavelet-Based Image Compression System on a Field-Programmable Gate Array
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: The increasing significance of having an efficient compression method for raw images before transmission or storage stems from their substantial storage requirements on computer hard drives. The proposed method for compressing images necessitated the implementation of a hardware design pipeline to execute a two-dimensional Distributed Arithmetic (DA) for the Discrete Wavelet Transform (DWT). Before conducting the conventional two-dimensional discrete wavelet transform (DWT) on the input image, the Distributed Arithmetic (DA) technique employs a lookup table (LUT) based FPGA architecture to construct a filter bank devoid of multipliers. In image compression, utilizing Differential Pulse-Code Modulation (DPCM) involves the computation of the Discrete Wavelet Transform (DWT) and the corresponding wavelet coefficients. The Huffman encoder, constructed by amalgamating the least probable symbols, is then provided with the modified image for compression. The efficacy of the revised DA-based wavelet is assessed by using a Simulink model before its implementation. In the context of this approach, the code is implemented using the Verilog programming language. The proposed methodology evaluates the traditional approach concerning adders, multipliers, internal memory capacity, computation time, power consumption, image dimensions, and hardware efficacy.

articleTitle: Malicious URL Analysis Using a Suite of Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Recognizing and classifying dangerous URLs is essential for assuring user safety in light of the exponential growth of Internet usage. Numerous cyber threats, such as phishing, malware distribution, and identity theft, are enabled by malicious URLs. This research seeks to enhance user safety by developing a classification algorithm based on machine learning that can differentiate between malicious and secure URLs. A massive database of potentially dangerous and secure URLs is analyzed in the first stage of the research process. The URLs are preprocessed to eliminate redundant information and extract pertinent properties (such as length, symbols, numerals, and characters). Frequently, the dataset is divided into training and test sets so that various classifiers can be compared directly. This study uses six distinct machine learning algorithms to detect and classify malicious URLs: Random Forest, XGBoost, Support vector machine, convolutional neural network, recurrent neural network, and artificial neural network. The results that cast light on the algorithm's performance are accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 scores. The study discovered that the recommended CNN model distinguished malicious from secure URLs with a success rate of 99.9%. Examining criteria such as URL length and symbol usage significantly improves classification accuracy. The research also examines whether URL IP addresses can be used as indicators of malicious intent. This research's findings can be applied to detecting and preventing intrusions employing malicious URLs. This study arrived at the chosen categorization approach through comparison; it will serve as the basis for future research and real-world implementations in cybersecurity. Increases user security against cyberattacks and data intrusions by precisely labeling and detecting problematic URLs.

articleTitle: Model Predictive Control Based STATCOM to Enhance Power Quality in Power System
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: The power quality problems and the sudden load changes of the electricity are affecting the power grid, leading to an unsafe mode. To compensate reactive power in the grid, Static Synchronous compensator (STATCOM) is preferred. In this study, a static synchronous compensator based on cascaded H-bridge (CHB) converters is developed to provide reactive power correction for unbalanced grid conditions. The proposed control method, model predictive control (MPC), improves the low voltage ride-through capability. The various power quality issues are resolved by proposed system such as voltage sag, swell, unbalanced loads and harmonics. Here 7 level CHB inject power to the distribution network to regulate the system parameters. The analysis and findings of the suggested CHB-based STATCOM are obtained using the MATLAB/Simulink environment.

articleTitle: GCRS – Green Computing Resource Scheduler: An Optimized Energy Efficient Cloud Data Centers to Scale Down Carbon Emission
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Cloud computing is a powerful technology that is rapidly growing in popularity with energy consumption being a major concern. Cloud data centers consume a lot of energy, which can lead to high operating costs and carbon emissions. This is a significant bottleneck restricting the development of cloud computing. If people continue to rely on traditional data centers, the environmental impact of cloud computing will only get worse. Green cloud computing solutions are needed to address this challenge. Green cloud computing solutions are designed to utilize cloud resources while minimizing energy consumption efficiently. Cloud computing providers offer different levels of service, which are defined in service-level agreements (SLAs). SLAs typically include things like the availability of the service, the response time for requests, and the resources that are assigned to the cloud clients. Cloud computing providers try to best exploit their resources by allocating them to users which enhances utilization and lowers the idle time. This can be done by using scheduling algorithms. In the proposed work“ data centers or servers maintain data for clients to read and write. Servers are classified as read-and-write servers separately based on their capacity, and read-and-write tasks are assigned accordingly. The model uses every server's full potential, resulting in an environment that consumes less energy. The objective of the proposed Green Computing Resource Scheduling (GCRS) is to reduce the energy consumed and the carbon emitted by the data center through scheduling resources.

articleTitle: Heart Abnormality Detection Through Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: This research study aims to develop an algorithm using phonocardiograms and Deep learning to differentiate between normal and abnormal heart sounds. The increase in cardiovascular diseases (CVD's), primarily caused by unhealthy habits, necessitates efficient diagnosis. The study utilized 1055 data samples, with 833 being normal and 182 abnormal, each lasting 5 seconds. Logistic regression and a three-layered neural network were initially applied, yielding accuracies of 42% and 63%, respectively. By extracting features using spectral roll-off and reapplying the models, accuracies improved to 79% and 86%. Up sampling the data further increased the accuracies to 86% for logistic regression and 89% for the three-layered neural network. The findings demonstrate the potential of audio-based algorithms in diagnosing cardiovascular diseases accurately.

articleTitle: Continuous Monitoring and Optimization of a Boilers Temperature with the Relay Circuit
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Agro-based industries produce spare parts or components for agricultural usage such as tractor spares, harvester spares, plough, and tillage spares, etc. During the manufacturing process, the metals must need to be heated within the boiler up to the heating point of the metal for reshaping. The metals must be monitored and controlled continuously for a particular time. But some of the small-scale industries were struggling to monitor and control the temperature at a constant rate. This study presents the design and implementation of a temperature detector and controller for the boiler to control and maintain a constant temperature to regulate the heat process and make the metals heat up to the set value. Temperature sensing and control systems are used to regulate industrial boilers. A temperature sensor, an Arduino, and a relay circuit comprise the system in the design and execution of a temperature detector and controller for the boiler. The output is displayed on an LCD, which shows the set temperature as well as the speed of the motor in percentage.

articleTitle: Detection of Different Types of Ear Diseases in Infants Using Deep Learning for Early Treatment
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: The loss or inability of auditory sense is the most common sensory organ deficiency. Out of every 1000 new-borns, 5–6 are deaf or hard of hearing. They will not be detected until they are two or three years old, after which permanent trauma would have happened. One of the most prominent reasons for deafness in infants is due to ear diseases. Early detection of ear diseases is the top priority to prevent deafness in infants. This research work has developed and applied modified deep learning architecture such as AlexNet, mini GoogLeNet, and LeNet and compared the training by the three architectures. Of the three, AlexNet architecture detected and identified the presence of different ear ailments such as acute otitis media, glue ear, safe CSOM, otomycosis, other infections and also checked whether the ear is normal, with high accuracy.

articleTitle: Classification and Detection of Alzheimer's Disease: A Brief Analysis
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Detecting Alzheimer's disease early is crucial for timely intervention and treatment as it is a neurological ailment that gradually impacts daily functioning along with memory, thinking, and reasoning skills. Older people of age over 60, are mostly affected by this ailment. The cause is still unknown and may be hereditary. A lot of methods and approaches have been suggested, however, MRI scans are the most popular ones. A brief analysis of the MRI scans via digitized images is taken into consideration. The person's conditions are categorized into mild cognitive, mild demented, moderate demented, and severely demented. The proposed model is based on a deep learning approach. The optimization of the obtained result is done by tuning. Further, the SoftMax activation function is employed in the model to normalize the output of the neural network. The model has achieved an accuracy of 98.5% achieved. Importantly, this method has the potential to enhance early Alzheimer's diagnosis and detection, thus leading to improvement in patient health.

articleTitle: An Examination of Guaranteeing the Safety of Drinking Water using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Water is one of the greatest resources on earth. People need water to survive. It is important to know whether the water drank by people is potable or not - as the water is one of the necessary elements for live. Water resources of different regions should be analysed individually. This research study analyzes the water potability using the Indian Water Potability dataset from Kaggle. More specifically, this research study discusses about each water factor that influences the potability of water by statistical methods -Decision Tree algorithm. According to research, water features are independent to each other's. All the attributes must meet certain standards in order to obtain potable water.

articleTitle: Comparison of Time-Series Forecasting Models based on Prophets for Predicting Rainfall
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Forecasting rain is crucial from both the perspective of society and the economy. The preparation process of farming, drinking water systems, and other macroeconomic proiects depends on accurate rainfall forecasts. The amount of precipitation is a crucial climatic component and valuable environmental asset that has a wide range of effects on farming and daily life. For humans to produce and live, precisely correct weather predictions are crucial. The first goal of this research endeavor is to determine if Prophet-based systems are capable of forecasting rainfall across time series. In this study, time-series forecasting models based on prophets were compared for predicting rainfall. In terms of Root Mean Square Error (RMSE), it was discovered that Neural Prophet (NP) outperformed Facebook Prophet (FBP). When the actual and anticipated values of both Neural Prophet and Facebook Prophet were compared, it was found that Neural Prophet's predictions were more accurate than those of Facebook Prophet. It is observed from the experimental analysis that the RMSE of FBP is 2.85 and the RMSE of Neural Prophet is 2.25.

articleTitle: Enhancing Cloud Communication Security Through Forward Secrecy Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: This research study explores the implementation and evaluation of the forward secrecy algorithm in the context of cloud computing. Cloud services have become ubiquitous in various domains, necessitating robust security measures to safeguard sensitive data during transmission and storage. The forward secrecy algorithm presents a promising solution, combining asymmetric and symmetric key encryption to achieve data confidentiality and integrity, even in the face of session key com- promises. Through a comprehensive review of related literature, we identify gaps and limitations in existing approaches to cloud security. Our proposed algorithm is assessed using performance metrics, such as encryption and decryption times, key generation times, and throughput, in a simulated cloud environment with CloudSim. The results indicate significant enhancements in cloud security, with efficient communication and minimal overhead. By addressing challenges related to data privacy, multi-tenancy, compliance, and insider threats, the forward secrecy algorithm offers a robust defense against potential attacks and bolsters the overall security posture of cloud computing environments.

articleTitle: Area and Energy Efficient Method Using AI for Noise Cancellation in Ear Phones
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Adaptive filters are suitable for most of the Digital Signal Processing (DSP) applications such as channel equalization, noise cancellation, echo cancellation, channel estimation and system identification. Nowadays due to the advancement in semiconductor technology, the need for Active Noise Cancellation (ANC) headphones in compact devices is increased. The major idea behind this proposed work is to design an area and energy efficient novel adaptive filter suitable for in-ear headphones by combining Normalized Least Mean Square (NLMS) and Block LMS (BLMS). The proposed filter is designed and simulated using Xilinx ISE 13.2. The simulation results shows that the proposed design mitigates the unwanted noises in various frequency bands.

Author Keywords: Recursive Least Square and Block LMS

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Techniques for Efficient Resource Utilization in Cloud Environments Through VM Placement Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: This study focuses on evaluating and comparing different VM placement techniques in a simulated cloud environment. The performance metrics, including resource utilization, load balancing, number of servers used, average response time, fault tolerance, and storage capacity, are analyzed for each technique. The results indicate that the Supervised technique achieves the highest resource utilization, load balancing, and storage capacity, along with the lowest average response time. The Bin Packing technique demonstrates efficient server utilization and medium fault tolerance. The Load-Aware and Genetic techniques exhibit a trade-off between resource utilization, load balancing, and fault tolerance. These findings provide valuable insights into selecting appropriate VM placement techniques based on specific requirements.

articleTitle: Monitoring Dust Pollution in Textile Industries
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: To track the level of cotton dust in the textile sector, an IOT-based cotton dust monitoring system is deployed. The system transfers the obtained data over a great distance using Wi-Fi protocol. The level of cotton dust is measured using an optical dust sensor. In addition to being shown on LCDs in the textile sector, the cotton dust level is tracked using a mobile application. A buzzer is used in the textile industry to indicate when cotton dust levels are above the permitted range (0.5 mg/m3), and an exhaust fan is also turned on as part of the dust management system. GP2Y1010AU0F is the optical dust sensor that measures and displays the quantity of cotton dust that is present in the textile industry. When cotton dust concentrations surpass the permitted limit (0.5 mg/m3) in the textile industry, a buzzer sounds. Additionally, IOT is used to convey the current dust concentration to mobile devices. Use of an exhaust fan or a water sprayer can be used to regulate cotton dust levels.

articleTitle: COPD Assessment Through Multimodal Analysis: Exploiting the Synergy of CNNs and LSTM Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 International Conference on Self Sustainable Artificial Intelligence Systems (ICSSAS)
abstract: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD) is a prevalent respiratory condition that requires accurate assessment for effective management. The paper proposes a novel approach that leverages the combined power of CNNs and LSTM networks for COPD assessment through multimodal analysis. The objective of the study is to enhance the accuracy and reliability of COPD diagnosis by exploiting the synergy between CNNs and LSTM networks using a comprehensive dataset comprising lung function measurements, clinical history, and imaging data.
